unit.text: The day appointed for the coming into operation of Part VII of the 1998 Act shall be 6th November 2000 (in this Order referred to as “the commencement date”).

UK_nisr_2000_399/6f21c60929.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>Police (Northern Ireland) Act 1998 (Commencement) Order (Northern Ireland) 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-11-02"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Police (Northern Ireland) Act 1998 (Commencement) Order (Northern Ireland) 2000.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Police (Northern Ireland) Order 1987 (S.I. 1987/938 (N.I. 10))">1987 Order</Abbreviation>” means the Police (Northern Ireland) Order 1987<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Police (Northern Ireland) Act 1998 c. 32">1998 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Police (Northern Ireland) Act 1998;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Chief Constable” includes a person discharging the functions of the Chief Constable;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the commencement date” has the meaning assigned thereto by Article 3 below;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="the Independent Commission for Police Complaints for Northern Ireland">the Commission</Abbreviation>” means the Independent Commission for Police Complaints for Northern Ireland established in pursuance of Article 3(1) of the 1987 Order;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“complaint” has the meaning assigned to it by section 50 of the 1998 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the former complaint provisions” means the provisions applicable to complaints against members of the Police force in operation immediately before the commencement date; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland">the Ombudsman</Abbreviation>” means the Police Ombudsman for Northern Ireland established by section 51 of the 1998 Act.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into operation of Part VII of the 1998 Act shall be 6th November 2000 (in this Order referred to as “the commencement date”).</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Article applies to any complaint falling to be dealt with before the commencement date under the former complaints provisions and not disposed of in accordance with those provisions by that date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to the following provisions of this Order any such complaint shall, as from the commencement date, continue to be dealt with as if Part VII of the 1998 Act had been in operation at the date on which it was made or recorded and as if anything done or falling to be done in relation thereto before the commencement date under any of the former complaints provisions was done or fell to be done in relation thereto under the corresponding provision of the said Act and the regulations made thereunder, and, in particular—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where any such complaint has been submitted to the Chief Constable under Article 4(1) of the 1987 Order but not yet recorded under Article 5(1) of the 1987 Order he shall upon receipt refer it immediately to the Ombudsman;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where any such complaint was recorded under Article 5(1) of the 1987 Order it shall be treated as having been recorded under section 52 of the 1998 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/c" id="article-4-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where under Article 5(3) of the 1987 Order, the Chief Constable has caused any such complaint to be investigated and has appointed a member for that purpose, the member shall be treated as having been appointed to investigate the complaint formally under section 57 of the 1998 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/d" id="article-4-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where a copy of the report of an investigation of any such complaint has been sent to the Director of Public Prosecutions under Article 10(4) of the 1987 Order, it shall be treated as having been sent under Section 58(2) of the 1998 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/4/2/e" id="article-4-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where, under Article 13 of the 1987 Order a recommendation has been made or a direction given by the Commission to the Chief Constable as to disciplinary charges to be preferred by him in relation to any such complaint, the recommendation or direction shall be treated as made or given to him by the Ombudsman in relation to that complaint under section 59 of the 1998 Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2000/399/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2000/399/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Any regulations made under section 25, 26, 59(8) and 64 of the 1998 Act shall apply to any complaint recorded under the former complaint provision and not disposed of before the commencement date.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Pollution Control and Local Government (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 (S.I. 1978/1049 (N.I.19))">1978 Order</Abbreviation>” means the Pollution Control and Local Government (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 <FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Litter (Northern Ireland) Order 1994 (S.I. 1994/1896 (N.I. 10))">1994 Order</Abbreviation>” means the Litter (Northern Ireland) Order 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Regulation (Northern Ireland) Order 1997 (S.I. 1997/276 (N.I. 2))">1997 Order</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Regulation (Northern Ireland) Order 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act (Northern Ireland) 2011 c. 23 (N.I.)">2011 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act (Northern Ireland) 2011; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“prescribed place” means a place prescribed in the Dog Fouling (Prescription of Places) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The day appointed for the coming into operation of the provisions of the 2011 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 (where applicable, to the extent specified in the second column of that Schedule) is 18th January 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into operation of the provisions of the 2011 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 (where applicable, to the extent specified in the second column of that Schedule) is 1st April 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (2) and notwithstanding its repeal by section 77 of, and Part 3 of Schedule 4 to, the 2011 Act, Article 4 of the 1994 Order continues, in respect of any place which is a prescribed place before midnight on 31st March 2012, to have effect.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any place which is a prescribed place before midnight on 31st March 2012 ceases to be a prescribed place after midnight on 31st March 2012 to the extent that a dog control order (whether or not it relates to the fouling of land by dogs) made under section 40 of the 2011 Act applies in respect of it.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In respect of the continued effect of Article 4 of the 1994 Order—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/a" id="article-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Article 5 of the 1994 Order continues to have effect in relation to an offence under Article 4 of that Order as if the amendments made to Article 5 by section 15 of the 2011 Act and the repeal of the definition of “authorised officer” in Article 2(2) of the 1994 Order by section 77 of, and Part 2 of Schedule 4 to, the 2011 Act had not been made;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/b" id="article-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Article 6 of the 1994 Order continues to have effect in relation to an offence under Article 4 of that Order as if the amendments made to Article 6 by section 16 of the 2011 Act and the repeal of the definition of “authorised officer” in Article 2(2) of the 1994 Order by section 77 of and Part 2 of Schedule 4 to the 2011 Act had not been made; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c" id="article-3-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notwithstanding their repeal by Part 3 of Schedule 4 to the 2011 Act—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/i" id="article-3-3-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the words “or 4” in Article 5(1) and (4) of the 1994 Order;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/ii" id="article-3-3-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the words “or, as the case may be, Article 4” in Article 6(1) of that Order; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/3/3/c/iii" id="article-3-3-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the words “or 4” in paragraph 2(4)(d) of Schedule 2A to the Police (Northern Ireland) Act 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>,</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>continue to have effect.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The amendments made to the 1997 Order by—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 11 (which amends Articles 48 and 49 of the 1997 Order);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 (which amends Article 51 of the 1997 Order); and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 13 (which amends Article 52 of the 1997 Order),</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>of the 2011 Act do not have effect in relation to the operation of Articles 48, 49, 51 and 52 of the 1997 Order in respect of a vehicle described in paragraph (2).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A vehicle to which this Article applies is either—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>one on a road to which a constable has, before midnight on 31st March 2012, affixed a notice under Article 48(4) of the 1997 Order; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>one on a public road to which the Department has, before midnight on 31st March 2012, affixed a notice under Article 49(4) of the 1997 Order.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2012/13/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2012/13/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Article, “constable” and “the Department” have the meanings given by Article 2(2) of the 1997 Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006 (Commencement No. 1, Savings and Transitional Provisions) Order 2006</dc:title><Made Date="2006-09-28"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 1, Savings and Transitional Provisions) Order 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006 asp 11">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to the particular purpose specified in article 3, and to the savings and transitional provisions contained in article 4, the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act (except sections 53 to 55) is 6th October 2006 except for the following provisions–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 20(1) to (3); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 52 insofar as introducing paragraphs 6, 9(b), (h) to (l), (n) and (p) of schedule 2 to the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 52 insofar as introducing paragraph 9(d) of schedule 2 to the Act shall come into force on 6th October 2006 only for the purpose of the repeal of section 3 (pets not to be sold to children under twelve years of age) of the Pet Animals Act 1951<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a court has imposed, by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, a disqualification on a person from having custody of any animal or any specified kind of animal, section 40(11) of the Act shall apply to a person who breaches such an order as it applies to a person who breaches a disqualification order imposed under section 40(1) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person has been convicted of an offence under section 40(11) of the Act, by virtue of breaching a disqualification imposed by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 39 of the Act shall have effect with the substitution for the words “owning or keeping an animal” in subsection (10)(d) of “having custody of an animal in breach of disqualification under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1954/40" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1954" Number="0040">1954 (c. 40)</Citation>”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person has custody of an animal in breach of a disqualification imposed by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 41 of the Act shall apply to such a breach as it does to a breach of a disqualification order imposed under section 40(1) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/d" id="article-4-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person is disqualified, by virtue of an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 42 of the Act shall apply as it does in relation to a person who is disqualified by virtue of an order under section 40(1) of the Act with the exception of section 42(2)(c)(i) which shall be omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any Code of Recommendations issued under section 3 of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> shall be treated as an animal welfare code of practice made by the Scottish Ministers under section 37 of the Act and approved by resolution of the Scottish Parliament.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 2, 6, 7 and 8<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968 shall continue to apply for the purposes of the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Scotland) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> and the Welfare of Livestock (Prohibited Operations) Regulations 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement No. 1, Transitional, Transitory and Saving Provisions) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-09-13"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation><Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1, Transitional, Transitory and Saving Provisions) Order 2012 and comes into force on 1st October 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 asp 5">2005 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 asp 8">2012 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>1st October 2012 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the 2012 Act specified in column 1 of the Schedule to this Order (the subject-matter of which is described in column 2 of the Schedule).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a purpose is specified in column 3 of the Schedule in relation to any provision, that provision comes into force on 1st October 2012 for that purpose only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 35(1) of the 2012 Act (annual police plans) does not apply in respect of any yearly period which begins before 1st April 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which section 71 of the 2012 Act (Her Majesty’s inspectors of constabulary in Scotland) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The reference in section 34(5)(a)(ii) of the 2012 Act (strategic police plan) to the inspectors of constabulary is construed as if it were a reference to the inspectors of constabulary appointed under section 33(1) of the Police (Scotland) Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which section 6 of the 2012 Act (the Police Service of Scotland) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 42(4) of the 2012 Act (examination of Police Service by Auditor General) is modified as follows—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/a" id="article-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a), omit “or the Police Service”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/b" id="article-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), after “resources” insert “the chief constable considers will be”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which paragraph 33(11) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (interpretation) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of section 66 of the 2012 Act (investigations: procedure), the following terms in the section inserted by that section have the following meanings—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“chief constable” means the chief constable appointed under section 7 of the 2012 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“senior officers” means chief constables, deputy chief constables and assistant chief constables of police forces established under the Police (Scotland) Act 1967;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“superintendents” and “chief superintendents” mean superintendents and chief superintendents of police forces established under the Police (Scotland) Act 1967; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Authority” means the Scottish Police Authority.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which the repeal of section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>42 of the 2005 Act (reporting) by schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>8 to the 2012 Act comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Despite the amendments made by paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>68(15) and (16) of schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>7 to the 2012 Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/a" id="article-7-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>40(1), (3) and (6) of the 2005 Act (framework document) continue to have effect on and after 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012 as they had effect before that date, but only in relation to the framework document given effect by the Fire and Rescue Services (Framework) (Scotland) Order 2012<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b" id="article-7-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>41(1), (2), (4), (5) and (6) of the 2005 Act (adherence) continue to have effect on and after 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012 as they had effect before that date, but only in relation to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/i" id="article-7-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the framework document mentioned in paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>(a); and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/ii" id="article-7-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>any order made under section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>41(4) of the 2005 Act before 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/1" id="article-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraphs (2) and (3) have effect until the day on which the amendments made by paragraph 68(20) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act come into force (interpretation).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/2" id="article-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of section 114 of the 2012 Act (strategic plan), in relation to the insertion of section 41A into the 2005 Act (SFRS’s first strategic plan), the reference in section 41A(4)(a) to the framework document is construed as a reference to the document prepared under, and having effect by virtue of, section 40 of the 2005 Act as amended by paragraph 68(15) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (SFRS framework document).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/3" id="article-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph 68(16) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (adherence to framework document), in relation to the amendments made to section 41 of the 2005 Act, the references in those amendments to the framework document are construed as references to the document prepared under, and having effect by virtue of, section 40 of the 2005 Act as amended by paragraph 68(15) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (SFRS framework document).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Civic Government (Scotland) Act 1982 c. 45">1982 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Civic Government (Scotland) Act 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Regulatory Reform (Scotland) Act 2014 asp 3">2014 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Regulatory Reform (Scotland) Act 2014.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (2), 30th June 2014 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the 2014 Act specified in column 1 of the Schedule (the subject-matter of which is described in column 2 of the Schedule).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a purpose is specified in column 3 of the Schedule in relation to any provision specified in column 1 of the Schedule, that provision comes into force on 30th June 2014 for that purpose only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>1st April 2015 is the day appointed for the coming into force of paragraph 11(4) of schedule 3 to the 2014 Act and, only in so far as necessary for the purpose of commencing that sub-paragraph, section 57 (consequential modifications and repeals) of the 2014 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraph (2) applies in the case of an application for a street trader’s licence under section 39<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> of the 1982 Act which—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>requires to be accompanied by a certificate under subsection (4) of that section; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is made before 30th June 2014.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The licensing authority may accept a certificate under subsection (4) of section 39 of the 1982 Act if it has been issued by the food authority which is—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the food authority referred to in that subsection after amendment by section 56 of the 2014 Act; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/160/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2014/160/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the food authority referred to in that subsection as it stood prior to that amendment.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: The day appointed for the coming into force of the Act, insofar as not already in force, is 1st April 2015.

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Landfill Tax (Scotland) Act 2014 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2015</dc:title><Made Date="2015-03-11"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Landfill Tax (Scotland) Act 2014 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2015 and comes into force on 1st April 2015.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Landfill Tax (Scotland) Act 2014 asp 2">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Landfill Tax (Scotland) Act 2014.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of the Act, insofar as not already in force, is 1st April 2015.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Until any regulations made under section 18 of the Regulatory Reform (Scotland) Act 2014<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> (regulations relating to protecting and improving the environment) are in force, the Act has effect subject to the following modifications.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 12(4) (landfill sites and operators of landfill sites), for “the Regulatory Reform (Scotland) Act 2014” substitute “Part 2 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> or regulations made under section 2 of the Pollution Prevention and Control Act 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2015/109/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2015/109/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the definition of “authorisation” in section 39 (interpretation), substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“authorisation” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in section 12(1) and (2), a landfill permit under regulations made under section 2 of the Pollution Prevention and Control Act 1999; and</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in sections 9, 10, 12(3) and (4) and 31—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a waste management licence for the purpose of Part 2 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a landfill permit under regulations made under section 2 of the Pollution Prevention and Control Act 1999,</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Housing (Scotland) Act 2014 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provision) Order 2015 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Housing (Scotland) Act 2014 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provision) Order 2015 and comes into force on 13th July 2015. 2 In this Order, “the Act” means the Housing (Scotland) Act 2014 and “the 2006 Act” means the Housing (Scotland) Act 2006. 2 The day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act specified in column 1 of the Schedule (the subject-matter of which is described in column 2 of the Schedule) is specified in column 3 of the Schedule. 3 1 Subject to paragraph (2), where a tenancy exists on 1st December 2015— a section 19A(1) and (3)(b) of the 2006 Act (duty to ensure regular electrical safety inspections and to provide tenant with a copy of the record of any inspection) does not apply to that tenancy until 1st December 2016; b an electrical safety inspection as required by section 19A(1) must be undertaken no later than 1st December 2016, if the tenancy remains in existence on that date; c section 19A(2)(a) and (3)(a) (requirement to ensure inspection before the start of the tenancy and provide the tenant with a copy of the record of the most recent inspection) does not apply; and d section 19A(3)(b) (duty to provide the tenant with a copy of the record of any inspection carried out during the tenancy) is complied with by providing the tenant with a copy of the most recent inspection. 2 Where an electrical safety inspection that complies with the requirements of paragraph (3) has been undertaken in the period beginning with 1st January 2012 and ending with 30th November 2015 and the tenant has been provided with a copy of the record of that inspection, any duty under section 19A(1) of the 2006 Act is complied with for a period of 5 years from the date of that inspection. 3 The requirements are those set out in sections 19A(1) and 19B of the 2006 Act, without the requirement for inspection of electrical appliances. <Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Inquiries into Fatal Accidents and Sudden Deaths etc. (Scotland) Act 2016 (Commencement No. 3, Transitional and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2017</dc:title><Made Date="2017-05-16"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Inquiries into Fatal Accidents and Sudden Deaths <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> (Scotland) Act 2016 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3, Transitional and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2017 and come into force on 15th June 2017.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fatal Accidents and Sudden Deaths Inquiry (Scotland) Act 1976 c. 14">1976 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fatal Accidents and Sudden Deaths Inquiry (Scotland) Act 1976<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Inquiries into Fatal Accidents and Sudden Deaths etc. (Scotland) Act 2016 asp 2">2016 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Inquiries into Fatal Accidents and Sudden Deaths etc. (Scotland) Act 2016.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>15th June 2017 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the 2016 Act, in so far as not already in force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>References to an “inquiry” in sections 30 to 35 of the 2016 Act (further inquiry proceedings) include reference to an inquiry under the 1976 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Despite the repeal of the 1976 Act by section 39(1) of the 2016 Act, the 1976 Act and the Fatal Accident and Sudden Deaths Inquiry Procedure (Scotland) Rules 1977<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> continue to have effect in relation to any inquiry applied for under section 1(1) or 1A(4)(b) of the 1976 Act before 15th June 2017.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraphs 1 to 15 of schedule 2 of the 2016 Act (modification of enactments) do not apply to inquiries to which the 1976 Act continues to apply by virtue of paragraph (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An inquiry under the 2016 Act is to be held into a death occurring before 15th June 2017 where—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/5/a" id="regulation-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 1(1)(a) or (b) or 1A(1) of the 1976 Act applies to the death; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/155/regulation/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/155/regulation/5/b" id="regulation-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>no inquiry has been applied for under section 1(1) or 1A(4)(b) of the 1976 Act.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph 15(a), (b) and (d) of schedule 9 of the Act come into force on 29 April 2027.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>

<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any application for a tobacco and vaping product banning order<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> under section 15<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> of the 2010 Act which is made, but not determined, before 29 October 2026 is to be treated as an application for a banning order referred to in section 15 of the 2010 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraphs (3) to (5) apply where a tobacco and vaping product banning order (being an order made under section 15 of the 2010 Act before 29 October 2026) has effect in respect of a person.</Text>

</P2>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 11(3)(b) (application for registration and addition of premises etc.)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 14(2) (changes to and removal from Register)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/3/c" id="regulation-3-3-c">

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/3/e" id="regulation-3-3-e">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/5" id="regulation-3-5">

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/6" id="regulation-3-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/6/a" id="regulation-3-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/6/b" id="regulation-3-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/210/regulation/3/7" id="regulation-3-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

               <P1para>
                  <Text>This Order may be cited as the Employment Protection Act 1975 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 1) Order 1975.</Text>

            </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/2" id="article-2">
               <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>The provisions of the Employment Protection Act 1975 specified in the Schedules hereto shall come into operation:—</Text>
                  <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
                     <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
                     <P3para>
                        <Text>in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 1, on 1st January 1976,</Text>
                     </P3para>
                  </P3>
                  <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
                     <Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
                     <P3para>
                        <Text>in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 2, on 1st February 1976,</Text>
                     </P3para>

                     <Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
                     <P3para>
                        <Text>in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 3, on 1st March 1976.</Text>
                     </P3para>
                  </P3>
               </P1para>
            </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/3" id="article-3">
               <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
                     <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>The repeal of the Conciliation Act 1896 or any repeal of the Industrial Courts Act 1919 brought into operation by this Order shall not affect the validity of anything done before the coming into operation of this Order by or in relation to the Secretary of State in pursuance of any of the repealed provisions of those Acts; and anything which at the time of the said coming into operation is in the process of being done by or in relation to or on the reference of the Secretary of State, shall be treated as if done and be continued by or in relation to or on the reference of the Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service, and in the case of a reference to a person or persons to whom any matter has been referred by the Secretary of State in pursuance of any of the repealed provisions of those Acts, that person or those persons shall be deemed to be a person or persons appointed under section 2 or 3 of the Employment Protection Act 1975, as appropriate.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
                     <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>Any matter which immediately before the commencement of section 10(2) of the said 1975 Act stood referred to the Industrial Arbitration Board under any enactment, statutory instrument or other document shall be treated as if it had been referred to the Central Arbitration Committee.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
                     <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>This Order shall not affect the validity of anything done before the date of the coming into operation of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 3 hereto for the purposes of any of the relevant statutory provisions within the meaning of the Health and Safety at Work <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> Act 1974; and anything which at that date is in process of being done for the said purposes (including in particular any legal proceedings) by or in relation to an inspector appointed by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food or the Secretary of State under section 19 of that Act may be continued by or in relation to an inspector appointed by the Health and Safety Executive under that section.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1975/1938/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
                     <Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>Agricultural health and safety regulations made under the said Act of 1974 and anything done or having effect under such regulations shall, if in force or of effect immediately before the date of the coming into operation of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 3 hereto, continue in force and have effect as if the said regulations were health and safety regulations within the meaning of that Act.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
               </P1para>
            </P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Employment Protection Act 1975 (Commencement No. 2) Order 1976</dc:title><Made Date="1976-02-03"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/1" id="article-1">
               <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>This Order may be cited as the Employment Protection Act 1975 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 2) Order 1976.</Text>
               </P1para>
            </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/2" id="article-2">
               <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>The provisions of the Employment Protection Act 1975 specified in the Schedules hereto shall come into operation—</Text>
                  <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
                     <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
                     <P3para>
                        <Text>in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 1, on 8th March 1976; and</Text>
                     </P3para>
                  </P3>
                  <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
                     <Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
                     <P3para>
                        <Text>in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 2, on 20th April 1976.</Text>
                     </P3para>
                  </P3>
               </P1para>
            </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3" id="article-3">
               <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
                     <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>Sections 99 and 100 shall not apply to any dismissal which, pursuant to a qualifying notice given before the date on which those sections come into operation, is to take effect before the expiry of the period of 90 days beginning with that date.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
                     <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>In determining for the purposes of section 99(3) or section 100(1) whether an employer is proposing to dismiss as redundant 100 or more, or, as the case may be, 10 or more employees, no account shall be taken of employees whose proposed dismissals, pursuant to a qualifying notice given before the date on which those sections come into operation, are to take effect before the expiry of the period of 90 days beginning with that date.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
                     <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>For the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2) above a qualifying notice is a notice complying with the requirements of section 1(1) of the Contracts of Employment Act 1972 (rights of employee to minimum period of notice) and the relevant terms of the contract of employment.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
                     <Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>Section 99(3) shall not apply to any dismissal which is to take effect on or after the date on which section 99 comes into operation where consultation with trade union representatives began before that date.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3/5" id="article-3-5">
                     <Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>For the purposes of paragraph (4) above consultation shall not be taken to have begun unless the employer has disclosed in writing to the relevant trade union representatives the matters specified in paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) of section 99(5).</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
                  <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/144/article/3/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/144/article/3/6" id="article-3-6">
                     <Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
                     <P2para>
                        <Text>In a case falling within paragraph (4) above section 100(1) shall have effect as if the words <InlineAmendment>“at least 90 days”</InlineAmendment> and <InlineAmendment>“at least 60 days”</InlineAmendment> in paragraphs (i) and (ii) respectively were omitted.</Text>
                     </P2para>
                  </P2>
               </P1para>
            </P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

               <P1para>
                  <Text>Sections 87 and 88 of the Employment Protection Act 1975 and Schedule 6 to that Act shall come into operation on 30th March 1976.</Text>

               <Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
               <P1para>
                  <Text>Where an appeal is transferred to the Employment Appeal Tribunal by virtue of paragraph 9 or 10 of Schedule 17 to the Employment Protection Act 1975 the Employment Appeal Tribunal shall have the same power to award costs in respect of that appeal as the High Court or the Court of Session, as the case may be, would have had if the appeal had not been so transferred.</Text>
               </P1para>
            </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1976/321/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1976/321/article/5" id="article-5">

               <P1para>
                  <Text>Nothing in this Order or in the Employment Protection Act 1975 shall operate to transfer an appeal to the Employment Appeal Tribunal if the High Court or the Court of Session has, before 30th March 1976, entered upon the consideration of that appeal.</Text>

            <P1para>
               <Text>The following transitional provisions shall have effect:—</Text>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
                  <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>Any warrant issued, arrest made or other thing or procedure done or instituted before the commencement date under an enactment or power which, by virtue of Article 2 above, is repealed or abolished as from that date, shall continue to have effect and may be continued or enforced, as if the said enactment or power had not been so repealed or abolished.</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
                  <Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>Part IV of the Act (detention) shall apply only where the period of detention commenced on or after the commencement date and, in relation to any person detained by the police on or after that date whose detention commenced before that date, the enactments and rules of law replaced by the said Part IV shall continue to have effect;</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
                  <Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>the following provisions of the Act, namely—</Text>
                     <UnorderedList Decoration="none">
                        <ListItem>
                           <Para>
                              <Text>Part VII (documentary evidence in criminal proceedings);</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem>
                           <Para>
                              <Text>Part VIII (evidence in criminal proceedings—general);</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem>
                           <Para>
                              <Text>Schedule 3 (provisions supplementary to sections 68 and 69);</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem>
                           <Para>
                              <Text>Paragraph 41 of Schedule 6 (so far as it amends paragraph 7 of Schedule 7 to the Value Added Tax Act 1983); and</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                        <ListItem>
                           <Para>
                              <Text>Parts II to V of Schedule 7 (repeals consequential on Parts VII and <Acronym Expansion="8">VIII</Acronym> of the Act,</Text>
                           </Para>
                        </ListItem>
                     </UnorderedList>
                  </P3para>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>shall not apply—</Text>
                     <P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/c/i" id="article-3-c-i">
                        <Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
                        <P4para>
                           <Text>to a trial; or</Text>
                        </P4para>
                     </P4>
                     <P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/1934/article/3/c/ii" id="article-3-c-ii">
                        <Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
                        <P4para>
                           <Text>to proceedings before a magistrates' court acting as examining justices,</Text>
                        </P4para>
                     </P4>
                  </P3para>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>which began before the commencement date.</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
            </P1para>
         </P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (Commencement No. 3) Order 1985 1 This Order may be cited as the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (Commencement No. 3) Order 1985. 2 Subject to Article 3 below, the provisions of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (hereinafter called “the Act”) specified in the Schedule to this Order shall come into force on 1st January 1986 (hereinafter called “the commencement date”). 3 The following transitional provisions shall have effect:— a Any warrant issued, arrest made or other thing or procedure done or instituted before the commencement date under an enactment or power which, by virtue of Article 2 above, is repealed or abolished as from that date, shall continue to have effect and may be continued or enforced, as if the said enactment or power had not been so repealed or abolished. b Part IV of the Act (detention) shall apply only where the period of detention commenced on or after the commencement date and, in relation to any person detained by the police on or after that date whose detention commenced before that date, the enactments and rules of law replaced by the said Part IV shall continue to have effect; c the following provisions of the Act, namely— Part VII (documentary evidence in criminal proceedings); Part VIII (evidence in criminal proceedings—general); Schedule 3 (provisions supplementary to sections 68 and 69); Paragraph 41 of Schedule 6 (so far as it amends paragraph 7 of Schedule 7 to the Value Added Tax Act 1983); and Parts II to V of Schedule 7 (repeals consequential on Parts VII and VIII of the Act, shall not apply— i to a trial; or ii to proceedings before a magistrates' court acting as examining justices, which began before the commencement date. SCHEDULE PROVISIONS OF THE POLICE AND CRIMINAL EVIDENCE ACT 1984 COMING INTO FORCE ON 1ST JANUARY 1986
