<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (Commencement No. 2) Order 1985</dc:title><Made Date="1985-04-17"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/1" id="article-1">
            <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <Text>This Order may be cited as the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 2) Order 1985.</Text>
            </P1para>
         </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/2" id="article-2">
            <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <Text>In this Order—</Text>
               <UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d001">the 1964 Act</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d001">the Police Act 1964;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d002">the 1976 Act</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d002">the Police Act 1976;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d003">the 1984 Act</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d003">the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d004">the Authority</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d004">the Police Complaints Authority established in pursuance of section 83(1) of the 1984 Act;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d005">the Board</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d005">the Police Complaints Board established in pursuance of section 1 of the 1976 Act;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d006">chief officer</Term>” <Definition TermRef="d006">includes a person discharging the functions of a chief officer;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d007">the commencement date</Term>” <Definition TermRef="d007">has the meaning assigned thereto by Article 3 below;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d008">complaint</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d008">a complaint about the conduct of a member of a police force;</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
                  <ListItem>
                     <Para>
                        <Text>“<Term id="d009">the former complaints provisions</Term>” means <Definition TermRef="d009">the provisions applicable to complaints against members of police forces in force immediately before the commencement date.</Definition>
                        </Text>
                     </Para>
                  </ListItem>
               </UnorderedList>
            </P1para>
         </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/3" id="article-3">
            <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
                  <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>
                        <Definition TermRef="d010">Subject to paragraph (2) below, the provisions of the 1984 Act specified in the Schedule to this Order shall come into force on 29th April 1985 (in this Order referred to as “<Term id="d010">the commencement date</Term>”).</Definition>
                     </Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
                  <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>In relation to an appeal by a member of a police force to the Secretary of State under section 37 of the 1964 Act (discipline appeals), written notice of which was received by the Secretary of State before the commencement date, the said section 37, and Schedule 5 to the 1964 Act, shall continue to have effect as they had effect immediately before the commencement date.</Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
                  <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>Appendix B to Schedule 2 to the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 (Commencement No. 1) Order 1984 (repeals taking effect from 1st March 1985) is hereby amended by the insertion following the words <InlineAmendment>“Section 5(3)”</InlineAmendment> of the words <InlineAmendment>“and section 17(6)”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
            </P1para>
         </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4" id="article-4">
            <Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
                  <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>This Article applies to any complaint falling to be dealt with before the commencement date under the former complaints provisions and not disposed of in accordance with those provisions by that date.</Text>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
               <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
                  <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
                  <P2para>
                     <Text>Subject to the following provisions of this Order any such complaint shall, as from the commencement date, continue to be dealt with as if Part IX of the 1984 Act had been in force at the date on which it was made, and as if anything done or falling to be done in relation thereto before the commencement date under any of the former complaints provisions was done or fell to be done in relation thereto under the corresponding provision of the said Part IX and the Regulations made thereunder, and, in particular—</Text>
                     <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
                        <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
                        <P3para>
                           <Text>where any such complaint was recorded under section 49(1) of the 1964 Act it shall be treated as having been recorded under section 85(1) of the 1984 Act;</Text>
                        </P3para>
                     </P3>
                     <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
                        <Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
                        <P3para>
                           <Text>where, under the said section 49(1), a chief officer has caused any such complaint to be investigated and has appointed an officer for that purpose, the officer shall be treated as having been appointed to investigate the complaint formally under section 85(3) of the 1984 Act;</Text>
                        </P3para>
                     </P3>
                     <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/c" id="article-4-2-c">
                        <Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
                        <P3para>
                           <Text>a request made before the commencement date by a chief officer or a police authority to the chief officer of another force to provide an officer for the purpose of carrying out an investigation of any such complaint shall be treated as if it had been made by him to that other chief officer in relation to that complaint under section 85(7) of the 1984 Act or, in the case of a complaint against a senior officer, by the police authority under section 86(3) of that Act.</Text>
                        </P3para>
                     </P3>
                     <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/d" id="article-4-2-d">
                        <Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
                        <P3para>
                           <Text>where the report of an investigation of any such complaint has been submitted to the Director of Public Prosecutions under section 49(3) of the 1964 Act, it shall be treated as having been submitted under section 90(4) of the 1984 Act;</Text>
                        </P3para>
                     </P3>
                     <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/e" id="article-4-2-e">
                        <Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
                        <P3para>
                           <Text>where a copy of a report of an investigation of any such complaint has been submitted to the Board with a copy of the complaint and a memorandum under section 2(1)(b) of the 1976 Act, the memorandum shall be treated as having been submitted to the Authority under section 90(7) of the 1984 Act; and</Text>
                        </P3para>
                     </P3>
                     <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/4/2/f" id="article-4-2-f">
                        <Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
                        <P3para>
                           <Text>where, under section 3(2) of the 1976 Act, a recommendation has been made or a direction given by the Board to a chief officer as to disciplinary charges to be preferred by him in relation to any such complaint, the recommendation or direction shall be treated as made or given to him by the Authority in relation to that complaint under subsection (1) or, as the case may be, subsection (3) of section 93 of the 1984 Act.</Text>
                        </P3para>
                     </P3>
                  </P2para>
               </P2>
            </P1para>
         </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/5" id="article-5">
            <Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <Text>Sections 87 to 89 of the 1984 Act (which provide for the supervision by the Authority of investigations into complaints and other matters) shall not have effect in relation to any complaint or other matter unless—</Text>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
                  <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>notice thereof was first received by the appropriate authority on or after the commencement date, and</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
                  <Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>the conduct to be investigated occurred, or is alleged to have occurred, on or after 29th April 1984.</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
            </P1para>
         </P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/6" id="article-6">
            <Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <Text>Where, immediately before the commencement date, there were in force under section 7(1) of the 1976 Act (arrangements between the Board and authorities maintaining bodies of constables other than police authorities) arrangements between the Board and any such authority as is referred to in that subsection, the arrangements shall, notwithstanding the repeal of that section, continue in force as if made in pursuance of an agreement under section 96 of the 1984 Act between the Authority and the authority in question, until—</Text>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/6/a" id="article-6-a">
                  <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>the end of 6 months from the commencement date, or</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1985/623/article/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1985/623/article/6/b" id="article-6-b">
                  <Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
                  <P3para>
                     <Text>a new agreement is made between the Authority and the authority in question under the said section 96,</Text>
                  </P3para>
               </P3>
            </P1para>
            <P1para>
               <Text>whichever is the earlier.</Text>
            </P1para>
         </P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991 (Commencement) Order 1992</dc:title><Made Date="1992-06-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991 (Commencement) Order 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 c. 27">1984 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991 c. 26">1991 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The 1991 Act shall come into force on 1st July 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a traffic authority has caused notice of intention to make an order under section 14 of the 1984 Act to be published pursuant to Schedule 3 to that Act before 1st July 1992, the traffic authority may make such an order in accordance with the notice and any regulations made under section 16 of that Act shall not apply to the order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a traffic authority makes an order on or after 1st July 1992 in accordance with a notice so published before that date, paragraph 2 of Schedule 3 to the 1984 Act shall apply to the order as if that paragraph had not been repealed by the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The 1991 Act shall not have effect in relation to an order made or notice issued under section 14 of the 1984 Act before 1st July 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
<P1para>

The New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992 1 1 This Order may be cited as the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992. 2 In this Order:— “the 1950 Act” means the Public Utilities and Street Works Act 1950; “the 1980 Act” means the Highways Act 1980; “the 1991 Act” means the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991; “special road authority” has the same meaning as in section 16(4) of the 1980 Act; “special road” has the same meaning as in the 1980 Act; “statutory undertaker” means a person entitled by virtue of a statutory right to carry out street works. 2 1 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 28th November 1992. 2 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st January 1993. 3 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 3 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st April 1993. 3 1 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given an advance notice of works for the purposes of section 54 of the 1991 Act. 2 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of the works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have settled a plan and section of the works for the purposes of Schedule 4 to the 1991 Act. 4 An undertaker who has given a notice under section 6(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of starting date of works for the purposes of section 55 of the 1991 Act. 5 An undertaker who has given a notice relating to the execution of emergency works under section 6(5) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of emergency works as required by section 57 of the 1991 Act and the works executed in reliance on such a notice shall be deemed to be emergency works for the purposes of section 57 notwithstanding any of the provisions of section 52 of the 1991 Act. 6 A street authority shall not restrict the execution of street works in a highway by notice under section 58 of the 1991 Act during the twelve months following the completion of substantial road works in any case where the highway authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted consent to an undertaker to break up or open that highway pursuant to section 156(5) of the 1980 Act. 7 Where a special road authority (within the meaning of section 16(4) of the 1980 Act) has on or before 31st December 1992 granted to a statutory undertaker consent to lay down or erect apparatus in any land comprised in the route of a special road, the consent of the street authority under section 61 of the 1991 Act for placing that apparatus in a protected street shall not be required. 8 The provisions of section 69 of the 1991 Act shall not apply to any street works which are in hand on 1st January 1993 or in respect of which any action required under section 26 of the 1950 Act has been taken before that date. 9 An undertaker shall not be subject to the provisions of section 70 of the 1991 Act if— a the street authority has elected to execute permanent reinstatement in accordance with the provisions of the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act and the undertaker is treated for the purposes of paragraph 5(2) of the said Schedule as having completed his works and such of the permanent reinstatement and making good as by virtue of the 1950 Act he is obliged to execute, provided however that an authority electing to exercise permanent reinstatement as aforesaid may not recover the cost of reinstatement from an undertaker unless the reinstatement has been completed on or before 31st December 1993 and an account has been rendered to the undertaker on or before 31st March 1994; or b the undertaker has begun permanent reinstatement on or before 31st December 1992; or c the street authority and the undertaker have agreed on or before 31st December 1992 that the street authority should execute permanent reinstatement and the reinstatement is executed in accordance with that agreement. 10 The provisions of sections 84(1), (3) and (4) and 85 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in any case where, on or before 31st December 1992, a highway, bridge or transport authority has given to an undertaker a notice of intention to execute works in accordance with paragraph 2(1) of Part I of the Fourth Schedule to the 1950 Act and has accepted that undertaker’s notice given under paragraph 3 of that Schedule as a specification of works and measures necessary to protect the undertaker’s apparatus. 11 Subsections (5) to (8) of section 73 of the 1991 Act shall apply to reinstatements carried out in accordance with section 7 of and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act. 12 Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1950 Act by section 168(2) of and Schedule 9 to the 1991 Act, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10 and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to permanent reinstatements begun by an undertaker on or before 31st December 1992 and to permanent reinstatements carried out by a street authority in the circumstances set out in article 9(a) of this Order. 13 Section 10(1) and 12(4) of the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to street works executed by a transport authority or a sewer authority which were begun on or before 31st December 1992. 14 Section 16 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force in relation to agreements to which that section applies which are made on or before 31st December 1992. 15 Section 8 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force until 31st March 1993 in relation to street works whether or not they were begun before 1st January 1993. <P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">

<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 28th November 1992.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">

<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st January 1993.</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 3 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st April 1993.</Text>

</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given an advance notice of works for the purposes of section 54 of the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of the works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have settled a plan and section of the works for the purposes of Schedule 4 to the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An undertaker who has given a notice under section 6(1)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of starting date of works for the purposes of section 55 of the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An undertaker who has given a notice relating to the execution of emergency works under section 6(5) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of emergency works as required by section 57 of the 1991 Act and the works executed in reliance on such a notice shall be deemed to be emergency works for the purposes of section 57 notwithstanding any of the provisions of section 52 of the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A street authority shall not restrict the execution of street works in a highway by notice under section 58 of the 1991 Act during the twelve months following the completion of substantial road works in any case where the highway authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted consent to an undertaker to break up or open that highway pursuant to section 156(5) of the 1980 Act.</Text>

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/7" id="article-7">

<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An undertaker shall not be subject to the provisions of section 70 of the 1991 Act if—</Text>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the street authority has elected to execute permanent reinstatement in accordance with the provisions of the Third Schedule<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> to the 1950 Act and the undertaker is treated for the purposes of paragraph 5(2) of the said Schedule as having completed his works and such of the permanent reinstatement and making good as by virtue of the 1950 Act he is obliged to execute, provided however that an authority electing to exercise permanent reinstatement as aforesaid may not recover the cost of reinstatement from an undertaker unless the reinstatement has been completed on or before 31st December 1993 and an account has been rendered to the undertaker on or before 31st March 1994; or</Text>

<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the street authority and the undertaker have agreed on or before 31st December 1992 that the street authority should execute permanent reinstatement and the reinstatement is executed in accordance with that agreement.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 84(1), (3) and (4) and 85 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in any case where, on or before 31st December 1992, a highway, bridge or transport authority has given to an undertaker a notice of intention to execute works in accordance with paragraph 2(1) of Part I of the Fourth Schedule to the 1950 Act and has accepted that undertaker’s notice given under paragraph 3 of that Schedule as a specification of works and measures necessary to protect the undertaker’s apparatus.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subsections (5) to (8) of section 73 of the 1991 Act shall apply to reinstatements carried out in accordance with section 7 of and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1950 Act by section 168(2) of and Schedule 9 to the 1991 Act, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to permanent reinstatements begun by an undertaker on or before 31st December 1992 and to permanent reinstatements carried out by a street authority in the circumstances set out in article 9(a) of this Order.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/13" id="article-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 10(1) and 12(4) of the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to street works executed by a transport authority or a sewer authority which were begun on or before 31st December 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/14" id="article-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 16 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force in relation to agreements to which that section applies which are made on or before 31st December 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/15" id="article-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 8 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force until 31st March 1993 in relation to street works whether or not they were begun before 1st January 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 c. 27">1984 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Act 1991 c. 40">1991 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Act 1991; and</Text>

</Para>
</ListItem>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Order, a London borough is a relevant London borough if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/a" id="article-1-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (1) of section 64 of the 1991 Act is in force in respect of that London borough,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/b" id="article-1-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsections (4) and (6) of section 67 of the 1991 Act are for the time being in force for the purposes of the subsections thereby inserted in relation to vehicles found in that London borough, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/c" id="article-1-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (2)(b) of section 68 of the 1991 Act is for the time being in force for the purposes of the subsection thereby inserted in relation to the council of that London borough.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/4" id="article-1-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Order, the City of London shall be treated as if were a London borough and the Common Council be treated as if it were the council of a London borough.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">

<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 42;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 66(7);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/e" id="article-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 71;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/f" id="article-2-f">

<P3para>

</P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">

<P3para>

</P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/h" id="article-2-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 6; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 8, to the extent that it relates to section 102 of the 1984 Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993 in respect of the London borough of Wandsworth only—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">

<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">

<P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/c" id="article-3-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 66, to the extent that it is not brought into force by article 2 of this Order;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/d" id="article-3-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 69;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/e" id="article-3-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 81, to the extent necessary for bringing into force the provisions of Schedule 7 brought into force by this article; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/f" id="article-3-1-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 5 of Schedule 7, to the extent that that paragraph is not already in force.</Text>
</P3para>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until subsection (1) of section 64 of the 1991 Act is fully in force, section 46 of the 1984 Act as amended by section 64 of the 1991 Act shall have effect as if “Greater London” meant so much of Greater London as consists of relevant London boroughs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/4" id="article-4">

<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 67 of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993 except that subsections (4) and (6) of that section shall so come into force only for the purpose of the application of the subsections thereby inserted in relation to vehicles found in the London borough of Wandsworth.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until subsections (4) and (6) of section 67 of the 1991 Act are fully in force, section 101 of the 1984 Act, as amended by section 67 of the 1991 Act, shall have effect as if “Greater London”, wherever it occurs, meant so much of Greater London as consists of relevant London boroughs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 68 of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993 except that subsections (2)(b) of that section shall so come into force only for the purpose of the application of the subsection thereby inserted in relation to the council of the London borough of Wandsworth.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until subsection (2)(b) of section 68 of the 1991 Act is fully in force, section 102 of the 1984 Act as amended by section 68 of the 1991 Act, shall have effect as if–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/a" id="article-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“London authority” meant the council of a relevant London borough, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/b" id="article-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (8), after the words “local authority” there were inserted the words “or from a parking place which is designated under section 6 of this Act but is not within the area of a relevant London borough as defined in The Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to a vehicle that is stationary in a designated parking place immediately before 5th July 1993, section 66(2) of the 1991 Act shall have effect for so long as it remains in that parking place as if the words “on or after 5th July 1993” were inserted after—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “left” in paragraph (a),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/b" id="article-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “payable” in paragraph (b),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/c" id="article-6-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “has” in paragraph (c).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a vehicle has been removed pursuant to any enactment before 5th July 1993, sections 67 and 68 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in relation to that removal or to any storage or disposal of the vehicle as a consequence of that removal.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993 1 This Order may be cited as the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993. 2 In this Order– “the Act” means the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993. 3 1 This Article has effect subject to the provisions of Articles 4 to 10 below. 2 The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th August 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 3 The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th September 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 4 All provisions of the Act insofar as they are not in force immediately before 1st October 1993, with the exception of those mentioned in paragraph (5) of this Article, shall come into force on 1st October 1993. 5 Sections 30, 33, 34 and 35 of the Act shall come into force on 1st January 1994. 4 1 Each of the following provisions shall apply only in relation to criminal proceedings which are commenced on or after the date when that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:– a any provision in Part II of the Act, except sections 28, 29, 40(1), 42(1) and 43; b any provision in Schedule 4 to the Act; c in Schedule 5 to the Act, any provision in any of the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 1, except sub-paragraphs (1), (5), (8), (9) to (29), (35) and (38); and d in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, any repeal which is consequential upon any of the above provisions; 2 For the purposes of paragraph (1) of this Article, criminal proceedings are commenced– a in summary proceedings, on the date of the first calling of the case; and b in solemn proceedings, on the date on whichever of the following first occurs:– i the grant of a warrant to arrest and commit; ii the intimation of a petition; and iii the service of an indictment. 5 Each of the following provisions shall apply only in a case where the trial has commenced on or after the date on which that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:– a section 40(1) of the Act; and b in Schedule 5 to the Act, sub-paragraph (5) of paragraph 1, and, for the purposes of this Article and Article 7 below, a trial shall be taken to commence when the oath is administered to the jury. 6 Without prejudice to section 17(2) of the Interpretation Act 1978(), insofar as anything done under or by virtue of section 274 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975(), as in force immediately before 1st October 1993, could have been done under or by virtue of the new provision, it shall have effect as if done under or by virtue of the new provision; and, for the purposes of this Article, the “new provision” means section 274 of that Act, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act. 7 Section 275 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act, shall apply in respect of any request made on or after 1st October 1993 for a transcript to be made of the proceedings at any trial, whether that trial commenced before or after that date. 8 Section 28 of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who is arrested or is detained under section 2(1) of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980() on or after 1st October 1993. 9 The following provisions of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st September 1993, namely:– a section 43 of the Act; and b in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, the repeal of paragraph 12 of Schedule 3 to the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980. 10 The following provisions shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st October 1993, namely:– a section 42(1) of the Act; and b in Schedule 5 to the Act, paragraph 1(9) to (26), (29) and (35). <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>

<Text>The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th September 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>

<Text>All provisions of the Act insofar as they are not in force immediately before 1st October 1993, with the exception of those mentioned in paragraph (5) of this Article, shall come into force on 1st October 1993.</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/5" id="article-3-5">

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Each of the following provisions shall apply only in relation to criminal proceedings which are commenced on or after the date when that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any provision in Part II of the Act, except sections 28, 29, 40(1), 42(1) and 43;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any provision in Schedule 4 to the Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, any provision in any of the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 1, except sub-paragraphs (1), (5), (8), (9) to (29), (35) and (38); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/d" id="article-4-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, any repeal which is consequential upon any of the above provisions;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph (1) of this Article, criminal proceedings are commenced–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in summary proceedings, on the date of the first calling of the case; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in solemn proceedings, on the date on whichever of the following first occurs:–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/i" id="article-4-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the grant of a warrant to arrest and commit;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/ii" id="article-4-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the intimation of a petition; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/iii" id="article-4-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the service of an indictment.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Each of the following provisions shall apply only in a case where the trial has commenced on or after the date on which that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 40(1) of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, sub-paragraph (5) of paragraph 1,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and, for the purposes of this Article and Article 7 below, a trial shall be taken to commence when the oath is administered to the jury.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Without prejudice to section 17(2) of the Interpretation Act 1978(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>), insofar as anything done under or by virtue of section 274 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>), as in force immediately before 1st October 1993, could have been done under or by virtue of the new provision, it shall have effect as if done under or by virtue of the new provision; and, for the purposes of this Article, the “new provision” means section 274 of that Act, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 275 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act, shall apply in respect of any request made on or after 1st October 1993 for a transcript to be made of the proceedings at any trial, whether that trial commenced before or after that date.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 28 of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who is arrested or is detained under section 2(1) of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>) on or after 1st October 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st September 1993, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/a" id="article-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 43 of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/b" id="article-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, the repeal of paragraph 12 of Schedule 3 to the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st October 1993, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/a" id="article-10-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 42(1) of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/b" id="article-10-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, paragraph 1(9) to (26), (29) and (35).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993 1 This Order may be cited as the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993. 2 In this Order– “the Act” means the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993. 3 1 This Article has effect subject to the provisions of Articles 4 to 10 below. 2 The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th August 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 3 The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th September 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 4 All provisions of the Act insofar as they are not in force immediately before 1st October 1993, with the exception of those mentioned in paragraph (5) of this Article, shall come into force on 1st October 1993. 5 Sections 30, 33, 34 and 35 of the Act shall come into force on 1st January 1994. 4 1 Each of the following provisions shall apply only in relation to criminal proceedings which are commenced on or after the date when that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:– a any provision in Part II of the Act, except sections 28, 29, 40(1), 42(1) and 43; b any provision in Schedule 4 to the Act; c in Schedule 5 to the Act, any provision in any of the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 1, except sub-paragraphs (1), (5), (8), (9) to (29), (35) and (38); and d in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, any repeal which is consequential upon any of the above provisions; 2 For the purposes of paragraph (1) of this Article, criminal proceedings are commenced– a in summary proceedings, on the date of the first calling of the case; and b in solemn proceedings, on the date on whichever of the following first occurs:– i the grant of a warrant to arrest and commit; ii the intimation of a petition; and iii the service of an indictment. 5 Each of the following provisions shall apply only in a case where the trial has commenced on or after the date on which that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:– a section 40(1) of the Act; and b in Schedule 5 to the Act, sub-paragraph (5) of paragraph 1, and, for the purposes of this Article and Article 7 below, a trial shall be taken to commence when the oath is administered to the jury. 6 Without prejudice to section 17(2) of the Interpretation Act 1978(), insofar as anything done under or by virtue of section 274 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975(), as in force immediately before 1st October 1993, could have been done under or by virtue of the new provision, it shall have effect as if done under or by virtue of the new provision; and, for the purposes of this Article, the “new provision” means section 274 of that Act, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act. 7 Section 275 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act, shall apply in respect of any request made on or after 1st October 1993 for a transcript to be made of the proceedings at any trial, whether that trial commenced before or after that date. 8 Section 28 of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who is arrested or is detained under section 2(1) of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980() on or after 1st October 1993. 9 The following provisions of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st September 1993, namely:– a section 43 of the Act; and b in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, the repeal of paragraph 12 of Schedule 3 to the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980. 10 The following provisions shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st October 1993, namely:– a section 42(1) of the Act; and b in Schedule 5 to the Act, paragraph 1(9) to (26), (29) and (35). <Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph (1) of this Article, criminal proceedings are commenced–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in summary proceedings, on the date of the first calling of the case; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in solemn proceedings, on the date on whichever of the following first occurs:–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/i" id="article-4-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the grant of a warrant to arrest and commit;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/ii" id="article-4-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the intimation of a petition; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/iii" id="article-4-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the service of an indictment.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Each of the following provisions shall apply only in a case where the trial has commenced on or after the date on which that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 40(1) of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, sub-paragraph (5) of paragraph 1,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and, for the purposes of this Article and Article 7 below, a trial shall be taken to commence when the oath is administered to the jury.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Without prejudice to section 17(2) of the Interpretation Act 1978(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>), insofar as anything done under or by virtue of section 274 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>), as in force immediately before 1st October 1993, could have been done under or by virtue of the new provision, it shall have effect as if done under or by virtue of the new provision; and, for the purposes of this Article, the “new provision” means section 274 of that Act, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 275 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act, shall apply in respect of any request made on or after 1st October 1993 for a transcript to be made of the proceedings at any trial, whether that trial commenced before or after that date.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 28 of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who is arrested or is detained under section 2(1) of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>) on or after 1st October 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st September 1993, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/a" id="article-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 43 of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/b" id="article-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, the repeal of paragraph 12 of Schedule 3 to the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st October 1993, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/a" id="article-10-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 42(1) of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/b" id="article-10-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, paragraph 1(9) to (26), (29) and (35).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">

<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government Finance Act 1992 (Commencement No.8 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>

<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Finance Act 1992 c. 14">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Finance Act 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall, so far as not then in force, come into force on 1st April 1993—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 99(2) and 111;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 11, paragraphs 29(a), 30, 32 to 36 and 38(b) and (e);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 13, paragraphs 2, 9, 35, 37(2), 38, 40, 44(a), (b) and (d), 53 to 56 and 93; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 14, the repeals listed in the Schedule to this Order.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The repeal by this Order of section 28B of the Registration of Births, Deaths and Marriages (Scotland) Act 1965(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>) shall not affect the operation of that section, or of regulations made under it, in relation to any death occurring before 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The repeal by this Order of subsection (2A) of section 18 of the Abolition of Domestic Rates Etc. (Scotland) Act 1987(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>) shall not affect the operation of that subsection in relation to any death occurring before 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect the operation of—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 110 and 118(1)(b) of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 5 to the Abolition of Domestic Rates Etc. (Scotland) Act 1987;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>in relation to any financial year beginning before 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
