UK_uksi_1994_1096/0d4e92754b.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Environmental Protection Act 1990 (Commencement No. 15) Order 1994</dc:title><Made Date="1994-04-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Environmental Protection Act 1990 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 15) Order 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“appropriate date”, in relation to an appeal, means the date on which—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the period for appealing expires without an appeal being made; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Bany appeal is withdrawn or finally determined;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“authorisation” has the meaning given in section 1(9) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“existing process” and “prescribed date” have the same meaning as in Schedule 3 to the Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant date”, in relation to an application for a licence, means the date on which the licence applied for is grantedor, if the application is (or is deemed to be) rejected, the date on which</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the period for appealing expires without an appeal being made; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any appeal is withdrawn or finally determined;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“scrap metal” has the same meaning as in the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 shall come into force on 1st May 1994</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 54 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 58 and 59;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 60 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 64 to 67 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 73 and 74 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(1) insofar as it relates to paragraph 27 of Schedule 15;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(2) insofar as it relates to the following repeals in Part II of Schedule 16—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the repeal of section 1 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in relation to Scotland only, the repeal of section 11 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set out in paragraph (3) below shall come into force on 1st May 1994, save for the purposes of their application to the following activities—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity which on that date is the subject of a pending application for a disposal licence under Part I of the Controlof Pollution Act 1974;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity in respect of which on that date an appeal in pursuance of section 10(1)(d) of the Control of Pollution Act 1974 (appeals to Secretary of State where a disposal licence is revoked) is pending or where the period for making such an appealhas not expired;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity which involves treating, keeping or disposing of scrap metal or motor vehicles which are to bedismantled;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d" id="article-2-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/i" id="article-2-2-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which on that date is the subject of a disposal licence under Part I of the Control of Pollution Act 1974;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/ii" id="article-2-2-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is or forms part of an existing process for which no authorisation has been granted; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/iii" id="article-2-2-d-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to which, if an authorisation were granted, section 33(1)(a) and (b) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 would not apply by virtue of the Waste Management Licensing Regulations 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions referred to in paragraph (2) are—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 33 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 35 to 40 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 42 and 43 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 44;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 57;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(1) insofar as it relates to paragraph 26 of Schedule 15;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(2) insofar as it relates to the following repeals in Part II of Schedule 16—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the repeal of sections 3 to 10, 18 and 27 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) below, the provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set outin article 2(3) (“the relevant provisions”) shall come into force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of their application to an activity falling within article 2(2)(a), on the day immediately following therelevant date in relation to the application in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of their application to an activity falling within article 2(2)(b), on the day immediately followingthe appropriate date in relation to the appeal in question.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (3)</Text>
</P2para>
<P2para>
<Text>below, where an activity falls within article 2(2)(c) (whether or not it also falls withinarticle 2(2)(a) or (b)), the relevant provisions shall come into force for the purposes of their application to that activity—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if on 1st October 1994 that activity is the subject of a pending application for a disposal licence under Part I of theControl of Pollution Act 1974, on the day immediately following the relevant date in relation to the application in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if on 1st October 1994 an appeal in pursuance of section 10(1)(d) of the Control of Pollution Act 1974 (appeals to Secretary of State where a disposal licence is revoked) is pending in respect of that activity or the period for making suchan appeal has not expired, on the day immediately following the appropriate date in relation to that appeal;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case, on 1st October 1994.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where an activity falls within article 2(2)(d) (whether or not it also falls within any other sub-paragraph of article 2(2)), the relevant provisions shall come into force for the purposes of their applicaton to that activity on the day immediatelyfollowing the prescribed date in relation to the process in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 (Commencement No. 5) Order 1995</dc:title><Made Date="1995-09-26"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 5) Order 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 1972 c. 70">1972 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Finance Act 1982 c. 32">1982 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Finance Act 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 c. 19">1994 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) to (4) the provisions of Part I of, and Schedule 2 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 1 to this Order shall come into force on 1st October 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1(5) of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the interpretation of “local authority” in Part III of the 1982 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 “local authority” in Part III of the 1982 Act shall be interpreted as including the district and county councils in Wales created as a result of the 1972 Act, as originally enacted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1(8) of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the interpretation of section 65(4) of, and paragraph 2 of Schedule 7 to, the Environment Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) the provisions of Part II of, and Schedules 6, 7 and 8 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 2 to this Order shall come into force on 1st October 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 the amendments made by paragraph 3(2) of Schedule 8 to the 1994 Act shall have effect only for the purposes of enabling a scheme to be made under section 63 of the Rent Act 1977<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> (schemes for appointment of rent officers) in relation to the new local government structure provided for by the 1994 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 62 of the Rent Act 1977 as in force immediately before the commencement of paragraph 3(2) of Schedule 8 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the provision of the rent officer service in Wales until 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) to (6) the provisions of Part VII of, and Schedules 15, 16 and 18 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 3 to this Order shall come into force on 1st October 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 the amendments made by paragraph 12 of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act shall have effect only for the purposes of enabling a local scheme to be made under section 14 of the Registration Service Act 1953<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> (preparation, submission and approval of local schemes) in relation to the new local government structure provided for by the 1994 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/3" id="article-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 21 of the Registration Service Act 1953 as in force immediately before the commencement of paragraph 12 of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the provision of the registration service in Wales until 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/4" id="article-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 the amendments made by paragraph 26 of Schedule 16 shall have effect only for the purposes of enabling an order to be made under section 1 of the Sea Fisheries Regulation Act 1966<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> (sea fisheries districts and committees) in relation to the new local government structure provided for by the 1994 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/5" id="article-5-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provision of the Sea Fisheries Regulation Act 1966 as in force immediately before the commencement of paragraph 26 of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in respect of any existing sea fisheries district and local fisheries committee in Wales until 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/2490/article/5/6" id="article-5-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made by paragraph 98 of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act shall have effect only in relation to any financial year beginning on or after 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6) Order 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>

</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/3" id="article-3">

<P1para>

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/4" id="article-4">

<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of Part II of, and Schedules 4 and 5 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 2 to this Order shall come into force on 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/5" id="article-5">

<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of Part VI of the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 3 to this Order shall come into force on 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2) the provisions of Part VII of, and Schedules 16 and 18 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 4 to this Order shall come into force on 1st January 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 the meaning of “local authority” in paragraph 5A(4) of Schedule 2 to the European Parliamentary Elections Act 1978<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall, in relation to Wales, be interpreted as including the district and county councils created as a result of the Local Government Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, as originally enacted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/3198/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of Part VII of, and Schedule 17 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 5 to this Order shall come into force on 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

UK_uksi_1995_546/29ec98cf74.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 (Commencement No. 3) Order 1995</dc:title><Made Date="1995-01-27"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3) Order 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 1972 c. 70">1972 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Representation of the People Act 1983 c. 2">1983 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Representation of the People Act 1983<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 c. 19">1994 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="the ordinary elections of councillors for new principal areas and for communities to be held on 4th May 1995">1995 ordinary elections</Abbreviation>” means the ordinary elections of councillors for new principal areas and for communities to be held on 4th May 1995;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“existing council” means a county or district council which will cease to exist as a result of the 1994 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“new principal area” means a county or county borough which is established by the 1994 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“new principal council” means the council of a new principal area.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 4 to 8 the provisions of Parts I, <Acronym Expansion="2">II</Acronym> and <Acronym Expansion="7">VII</Acronym> of, and Schedules 15, 16, 17 and 18 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in the Schedule to this Order shall come into force on 20th March 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1(5) and (8) of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the interpretation of sections 21, 25, 26, 79, 80 and 270(1) and (3) of the 1972 Act, and section 17 of the 1994 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (4) of article 8, the provisions of section 17 of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only in relation to the following legislative provisions—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Regulation 97(5) of the Representation of the People Regulations 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Rule 4 of the Local Elections (Principal Areas) Rules 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, Rule 4 in and the appendix of Forms to Schedule 2 to those Rules, Schedule 3 to those Rules and paragraphs 8, 18 and 24 of Schedule 4 to those Rules<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Rule 4 of the Local Elections (Parishes and Communities) Rules 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, paragraphs 4 and 20 of Schedule 3 to those Rules and paragraph 22 of Schedule 4 to those Rules;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Articles 2 and 4 of the Local Elections (Principal Areas) (Welsh Forms) Order 1987<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>The Local Elections (Principal Areas) (Declaration of Acceptance of Office) Order 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Article 2 of the Local Elections (Declaration of Acceptance of Office) (Welsh Forms) Order 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> .</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 21, 25(2), 26 and 270(1) of the 1972 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of sections 1(5), (8), 2 and 4 of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the administration of local government in Wales before 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 31(1), 35(1) and 36(3) of the 1983 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 68(6), (7) and (8) of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to electoral matters concerning existing councils.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/1" id="article-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to the commencement of paragraph 68(6) of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act, the power contained in section 31(1A) of the 1983 Act for the division of an electoral division into polling districts shall, for the 1995 ordinary elections, be exercisable by the existing council which appointed the returning officer for the area in question<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/2" id="article-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to the commencement of paragraph 68(8) of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act, the references in section 36(3AB) of the 1983 Act to elections to fill casual vacancies shall not apply in respect of casual vacancies occurring prior to 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3" id="article-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to the commencement of paragraph 68(16) of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/a" id="article-8-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the provision in section 36(6) of the 1983 Act whereby a council for a local government area other than a community may be required to advance expenses in relation to an election shall, for the 1995 ordinary elections, apply to the existing council which appointed the returning officer for the area in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/b" id="article-8-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the reference in regulation 96(2) of the Representation of the People Regulations 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> to the proper officer of the local authority for which the election was held shall, in relation to the 1995 ordinary elections, be construed as a reference to the person who is deemed to be the proper officer of that authority under paragraph 4 of Schedule 5 to the 1972 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> and any documents held by a person in accordance with this provision shall be transferred by him to the custody of the proper officer of the new principal council upon the appointment of that officer;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/3/c" id="article-8-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the references in Parts IV and V of Schedule 2 to the Local Elections (Principal Areas) Rules 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> to the proper officer of the council for which the election is held shall, in relation to the 1995 ordinary elections and until such officer is duly appointed, be construed as references to the person who is deemed to be the proper officer of that council under paragraph 4 of Schedule 5 to the 1972 Act, and any documents held by a person in accordance with this provision shall be transferred by him to the custody of the proper officer of the new principal council upon the appointment of that officer.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/546/article/8/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/546/article/8/4" id="article-8-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to the commencement of section 17 of the 1994 Act, the provision in paragraph (1) of rule 4 in Schedule 2 to the Local Elections (Principal Areas) Rules 1986, whereby nomination papers are to be delivered at the offices of the council of the district in which the electoral area wholly or mainly lies shall, for the 1995 ordinary elections, be construed as requiring such nomination papers to be delivered at the offices of the existing council which nominated the returning officer for the new principal area.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1943/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1943/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 3 below, section 18 of the Transport Act 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall come into force on the appointed day.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1943/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1943/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>During the period beginning with the appointed day and ending immediately before the day on which section 8 of the Transport Act 1982 comes into force, section 63A(3)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> shall have effect with the omission of the words “or by the prescribed testing authority”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: The following transitional provisions shall be made to each of the provisions of the Adoption (Scotland) Act 1978 (“the 1978 Act”) until the repeal of that provision in Schedule 5 to the Act comes into force.

UK_uksi_1996_2203/b94077352a.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Children (Scotland) Act 1995 (Commencement No.2 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1996</dc:title><Made Date="1996-08-22"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Children (Scotland) Act 1995 (Commencement No.2 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1996.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order–</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Children (Scotland) Act 1995 c. 36">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Children (Scotland) Act 1995;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968 c. 49">1968 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“local authority” means a council constituted under section 2 of the Local Government <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> (Scotland) Act 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 4 of the Act shall come into force on 1st September 1996 but only for the purpose of enabling regulations to be made under that section so as to come into force on or after 1st November 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 91 of the Act shall come into force on 1st October 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to the provisions of articles 4 to 7 of this Order, the provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of the Schedule to this Order and described by reference to the subject matter in column 2 of that Schedule shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 1st November 1996 but, where a particular purpose is specified in relation to any provision in column 3 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the coming into force of section 70 of the Act, and without prejudice to the then operation of section 17(2)(b) of the Interpretation Act 1978<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, the reference in section 3(4) of the Act to a supervision requirement made under section 70 of the Act shall be construed as including a reference to a supervision requirement made under section 44<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> of the 1968 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the coming into force of section 86 of the Act, and without prejudice to the then operation of section 17(2)(b) of the Interpretation Act 1978–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 7(5) of the Act, the reference to an order under section 86 of the Act shall be construed as including a reference to a resolution under section 16<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> or 16A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> of the 1968 Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 11(4)(d) of the Act, the reference to a case in which the parental responsibilities or parental rights have been transferred to a local authority by a parental responsibilities order shall be construed as including a reference to a case in which the relevant parental rights and powers in relation to the child (as defined in section 16(3) of the 1968 Act) have vested in a local authority or a voluntary organisation by a resolution under section 16 or 16A of the 1968 Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the coming into force of sections 52 and 69 of the Act, and without prejudice to the then operation of section 17(2)(b) of the Interpretation Act 1978–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/a" id="article-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the reference in section 54(1) to a condition in section 52(2)(a) to (h), (j), (k) or (l) of the Act being satisfied with respect to a child shall be construed as including a reference to a condition in section 32(2)(a) to (f), (gg) and (i) of the 1968 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> being satisfied with respect to a child; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b" id="article-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the reference in section 54(3)–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/i" id="article-6-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to compulsory measures of supervision shall be construed as including a reference to compulsory measures of care within the meaning of section 32 of the 1968 Act;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/ii" id="article-6-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to arranging a children’s hearing to consider the case of the child under section 69 of the Act shall be construed as including a reference to arranging a children’s hearing to consider the case of the child under sections 43 and 44 of the 1968 Act; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/6/b/iii" id="article-6-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to the application of section 69(1) of the Act shall be construed as including a reference to the application of sections 43 and 44 of the 1968 Act as if the condition specified by the court under section 54(1) of the Act as read with paragraph (a) above were a ground of referral established in accordance with section 42<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> of the 1968 Act.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following transitional provisions shall be made to each of the provisions of the Adoption (Scotland) Act 1978 (“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Adoption (Scotland) Act 1978 c. 28">1978 Act</Abbreviation>”)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> until the repeal of that provision in Schedule 5 to the Act comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 2(d) of the 1978 Act, the reference to “custody proceedings” shall be construed as including a reference to proceedings regarding a residence order under section 11(2)(c) of the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2203/article/7/3" id="article-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 32(4)(c) of the 1978 Act, the reference to an order awarding custody of a child should be construed as including a reference to a residence order under section 11(2)(c) of the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Section 120(1) of the Environment Act 1995 shall come into force on 21st November 1996 in so far as it relates to paragraphs 142, 143, 169, 170 and 183 of Schedule 22 in so far as the amendments made by those provisions confer any power to make regulations.

UK_uksi_1996_2909/e3649a8c1a.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Environment Act 1995 (Commencement No. 8 and Saving Provisions) Order 1996</dc:title><Made Date="1996-11-20"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Environment Act 1995 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 8 and Saving Provisions) Order 1996.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 120(1) of the Environment Act 1995 shall come into force on 21st November 1996 in so far as it relates to paragraphs 142, 143, 169, 170 and 183 of Schedule 22 in so far as the amendments made by those provisions confer any power to make regulations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 4, the following provisions of the Environment Act 1995 shall come into force on 31st December 1996—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 120(1) in so far as it relates to paragraphs 142, 143, 169, 170 and 183 of Schedule 22 in so far as those paragraphs are not already in force; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 120(3) in so far as it relates to the repeals made in Schedule 24 in relation to sections 91 and 190(1) of the Water Resources Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application of—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/i" id="article-4-1-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 5 of Schedule 10 to the Water Resources Act 1991 as originally enacted or as modified by the Control of Pollution (Discharges by the National Rivers Authority) Regulations 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/ii" id="article-4-1-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>regulations 2 to 6 of the Control of Pollution (Consents for Discharges <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) (Secretary of State Functions) Regulations 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to any application made under paragraph 1 of that Schedule (applications for discharge consents) before 31st December 1996 or any consent given under paragraph 5 of that Schedule (discharge consents granted without applications) before that date;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application of section 91 of the Water Resources Act 1991 as originally enacted (appeals in respect of consents under Chapter <Acronym Expansion="2">II</Acronym> of Part III of that Act), and regulations 2 and 7 of the Control of Pollution (Consents for Discharges etc.) (Secretary of State Functions) Regulations 1989, in relation to any appeal under that section made in relation to a decision taken before 31st December 1996;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the power to amend or revoke any of the regulations mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (1)(a) above shall not apply in relation to an application made under paragraph 1 of Schedule 10 to the Water Resources Act 1991 before 31st December 1996 if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application relates to discharges of a kind which the applicant, or a predecessor of his, was authorised to make by virtue of a consent to which paragraph 21 of Schedule 23 to the Environment Act 1995 (transitional provisions in relation to discharge consents) applied; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notice in accordance with sub-paragraph (2)(b)(ii) of that paragraph was not given by him or his predecessor.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Crime and Punishment (Scotland) Act 1997 (Commencement No.2 and Transitional and Consequential Provisions) Order 1997 1 This Order may be cited as the Crime and Punishment (Scotland) Act 1997 (Commencement No.2 and Transitional and Consequential Provisions) Order 1997. 2 In this Order– “the Act” means the Crime and Punishment (Scotland) Act 1997; and “the 1995 Act” means the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995. 3 The provisions of Parts I, II and VI of the Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order and whose subject matter is specified in column 2 of that Schedule shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on 20th October 1997, but, where a particular purpose is specified in relation to any provision in column 3 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 4 Subject to article 7 below, the provisions of Parts I, II, III and VI of the Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order and whose subject matter is specified in column 2 of that Schedule shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on 1st January 1998 but, where a particular purpose is specified in relation to any provision in column 3 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 5 1 Sections 5 and 24 of the Act shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on 1st July 1998. 2 Section 62 of the Act shall come into force on 1st July 1998 for the purpose of bringing into force the amendments made to the 1995 Act by paragraphs 21(27) and (28) of Schedule 1 to the Act. 6 1 The provisions of Part V of the Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 3 to this Order shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on the date specified in column 2 of that Schedule so as to enable the provisions of the 1986 Act which are specified in column 3 to the Schedule to come into force on that date for the purpose specified in column 4 of that Schedule. 2 Section 62(1) of the Act shall come into force on 1st October 1997 for the purpose of bringing into force the amendments to the 1986 Act which are made by paragraphs 12(2) to (4) and (8) to (10) of Schedule 1 to the Act. 3 Section 63(1)(b) of the Act shall come into force on 1st October 1997. 4 Where the name of a solicitor and any firm with which he is connected is not entered on the Register on 1st October 1998, the solicitor shall, in accordance with arrangements approved by the Board, forthwith and without waiting for the resolution of any appeal under section 25A(13) of the 1986 Act, transfer– a any work currently being undertaken by him for any client by way of criminal legal assistance; and b notwithstanding any lien to which he might otherwise be entitled, any documents connected with any such work, to a registered solicitor. 5 For the purposes of this article and Schedule 3 to this Order– “the 1986 Act” means the Legal Aid (Scotland) Act; “the Board” means the Scottish Legal Aid Board; “criminal legal assistance” means criminal legal aid and advice and assistance in relation to criminal matters; “document” includes information recorded in any form; “firm” includes an incorporated practice, a sole solicitor and a law centre; “the Register” means the Register established and maintained under section 25A of the 1986 Act; “registered firm” means a firm whose name appears on the Register; and “registered solicitor” means a solicitor whose name appears on the Register. 7 Sections 248A and 248B of the 1995 Act as inserted by section 15 of the Act shall not apply in relation to any offence committed before 1st January 1998. Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995. 3 The provisions of Parts I, II and VI of the Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order and whose subject matter is specified in column 2 of that Schedule shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on 20th October 1997, but, where a particular purpose is specified in relation to any provision in column 3 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 4 Subject to article 7 below, the provisions of Parts I, II, III and VI of the Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order and whose subject matter is specified in column 2 of that Schedule shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on 1st January 1998 but, where a particular purpose is specified in relation to any provision in column 3 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 5 1 Sections 5 and 24 of the Act shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on 1st July 1998. 2 Section 62 of the Act shall come into force on 1st July 1998 for the purpose of bringing into force the amendments made to the 1995 Act by paragraphs 21(27) and (28) of Schedule 1 to the Act. 6 1 The provisions of Part V of the Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 3 to this Order shall, in so far as they are not then in force, come into force on in column 4 of that Schedule. 2 Section 62(1) of the Act shall come into force on 1st October 1997 for the purpose of bringing into force the amendments to the 1986 Act which are made by paragraphs 12(2) to (4) and (8) to (10) of Schedule 1 to the Act. 3 Section 63(1)(b) of the Act shall come into force on 1st October 1997. 4 Where the name of a solicitor and any firm with which he is connected section 25A(13) of the 1986 Act, transfer– a any work currently being undertaken by him for any client by way of criminal legal assistance; and b notwithstanding any lien to which he might otherwise be entitled, any documents connected with any such work, to a registered solicitor. 5 For the purposes of this article and Schedule 3 to this Order– “the 1986 Act” means the Legal Aid (Scotland) Act; <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/744/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/744/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Children (Scotland) Act 1995 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3) (Amendment and Transitional Provisions) Order 1997.</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/744/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/744/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">

<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “the third commencement order” means the Children (Scotland) Act 1995 (Commencement No. 3) Order 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>

</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/744/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/744/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the third commencement order for Article 3(7) there shall be substituted the following–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Act, insofar as not already in force, shall come into force on 1st April 1997 except–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 98 of and paragraph 25 of Schedule 2 to the Act insofar as they insert new section 51A into the Adoption (Scotland) Act 1978, which shall come into force on 1st April 1998;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 101 of the Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the entry in Schedule 5 to the Act relating to the Trusts (Scotland) Act 1921<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the entries in Schedule 4, paragraph 26(8), and in Schedule 5 to the Act relating to section 103 of the Children Act 1975<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/744/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/744/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After Article 3 of the third commencement order there shall be inserted the following–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Transitional provisions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) and notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 3 of Schedule 3 to the Act, where the parental rights and powers in respect of a child have, by resolution under section 16 of the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, vested in a local authority or, as the case may be, a voluntary organisation and immediately prior to 1st April 1997 those rights remain so vested, provided–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the period of one month after the serving of a notice under section 16(5) of that Act has not yet expired and no counter-notice under section 16(7) of that Act has been served on the local authority; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a counter-notice under section 16(7) of that Act has been served, but there still remains unexpired part of the 14 days referred to in section 16(8) without the local authority having made a summary application to the sheriff under section 16(8) of that Act,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>then the provisions of the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968 shall continue to apply to the resolution under s16 of the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968 for the duration of whichever of the unexpired periods referred to in paragraphs (a) and (b) applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If a counter-notice referred to in sub-paragraph (1)(a) is served within the one month period specified in that sub-paragraph, the provisions of the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968 shall apply not for the remaining unexpired part of the month but for a further 14 days from the date of the serving of the notice or, if a summary application is made within that period, until the determination of that application by the sheriff.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If a summary application referred to in sub-paragraph (1)(b) is made within the unexpired part of the 14 days referred to in that sub-paragraph, the provisions of the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968 shall apply not for the remaining unexpired part of the 14 days but until the determination of the summary application by the sheriff.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If a summary application has been served before 1st April 1997 and is at that date still pending, the provisions of the Social Work (Scotland) Act 1968 shall apply until the determination of that application by the sheriff.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where prior to 1st April 1997 there has been lodged under Part II of the Adoption (Scotland) Act 1978<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> any application for an adoption order or for a freeing for adoption order, the provisions of that Act shall apply to those proceedings after 1st April 1997 notwithstanding any amendment or repeal of any provisions of that Act by the Children (Scotland) Act 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the terms of regulations 3 and 9 of the Arrangements to Look After Children (Scotland) Regulations 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> where on 1st April 1997 the child is looked after by the local authority for the purposes of section 17(6) of the Act the local authority must make a care plan in respect of the child and carry out a review of the child’s case within 6 months from 1st April 1997.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 89 of the Act (so far as it is not already in force) shall come into force on 6th January 1999.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Act specified in the Schedule to this Order shall come into force on 1st February 1999.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 89 of the Act shall not apply in relation to the determination of admission arrangements for any school year earlier than the school year 2000/2001.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Article and Article 4, admission arrangements are to be treated as being for the particular school year in which pupils are to be admitted to the relevant school in consequence of the arrangements.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any step taken, before the coming into force of section 89, by an admission authority for the purpose of consultation about their proposed admission arrangements for the school year 2000/2001 shall, except as specified in paragraph (2), be taken into account in determining whether that authority have complied with their duty to consult under that section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1998/3198/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1998/3198/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (1) does not apply to the extent that the step in question, had it been taken after the commencement of section 89, would have contravened any requirement applying under or for the purposes of that section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The School Standards and Framework Act 1998 (Commencement No. 7 and Saving and Transitional Provisions) Order 1999</dc:title><Made Date="1999-08-13"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the School Standards and Framework Act 1998 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 7 and Saving and Transitional Provisions) Order 1999.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Education Act 1996 c. 56">1996 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Education Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="School Standards and Framework Act 1998 c. 31">1998 Act</Abbreviation>” means the School Standards and Framework Act 1998.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In articles 10, 11 and 12 below “local authority” means a county council, a county borough council, a district council, a London borough council or the Common Council of the City of London.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/16" id="article-16">
<Pnumber>16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/1" id="article-16-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the repeal of Chapter <Acronym Expansion="8">VIII</Acronym> of Part III of the 1996 Act, sections 274 to 279 of the 1996 Act (winding up and disposal of property) and those sections as applied by regulation 33 of the Education (Grant-maintained Special Schools) Regulations 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> shall continue to have effect for the purposes of winding up and disposing of the property of a grant-maintained school or grant-maintained special school subject to discontinuance proposals, in cases where the governing body have not been dissolved before 1st September 1999.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/2" id="article-16-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph (1), “discontinuance proposals” means—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/2/a" id="article-16-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a grant-maintained school, proposals for the discontinuance of the school published under section 267 or 268 of the 1996 Act before 1st September 1999; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/16/2/b" id="article-16-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a grant-maintained special school, proposals for the discontinuance of the school published under section 339 of that Act before 1st September 1999.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/17/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/17" id="article-17">
<Pnumber>17</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where particulars of premises or proposed premises are approved on or after 1st September 1999 under—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/17/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/17/a" id="article-17-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 214 of the 1996 Act as that section continues to have effect by virtue of regulation 2 of the School Standards and Framework Act 1998 (Proposals under section 211 of the Education Act 1996) (Transitional Provisions) Regulations 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/2323/article/17/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/2323/article/17/b" id="article-17-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 39, 44, 262 or 341 of the 1996 Act as those sections continue to have effect by virtue of regulation 8 or 14 of the Education (Transition to New Framework) (School Organisation Proposals) Regulations 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>section 4(1)(a) of the Building Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> (exemption of education buildings from building regulations) shall have effect as if the repeal of the provisions in that subsection made by Schedule 31 to the 1998 Act had not come into force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
