<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Greater London Authority Act 1999 (Commencement No. 6 and Preliminary Arrangements for the Metropolitan Police Authority) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-04-16"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Greater London Authority Act 1999 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6 and Preliminary Arrangements for the Metropolitan Police Authority) Order 2000, and shall come into force on 10th May 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/a" id="article-1-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Greater London Authority Act 1999 c. 29">1999 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Greater London Authority Act 1999;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/b" id="article-1-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Police Act 1996 c. 16">1996 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Police Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/1/2/c" id="article-1-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“the operative date” means the date on which appointments to the Metropolitan Police Authority are first made under paragraph 3(3) of Schedule 2A to the 1996 Act (appointment of independent members)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Arrangements in relation to the Metropolitan Police Authority as to any matter specified in the Schedule to this Order made before 3rd July 2000 by the chief finance officer shall have effect on and after that date as if made by that Authority until replaced or altered by that Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article “chief finance officer” means the person who is, by virtue of his appointment under section 407 of the 1999 Act, for the time being the chief finance officer of the Metropolitan Police Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Standing orders for the first meeting of the Metropolitan Police Authority shall be prepared by the clerk to that Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The standing orders prepared in accordance with paragraph (1) shall provide for:</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>giving notice of the meeting;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>preparation of the agenda for the meeting;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>election of a chairman of the Metropolitan Police Authority;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/d" id="article-3-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>declaration of the result of that election;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/e" id="article-3-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the meeting to be chaired by the clerk to that Authority until that result has been declared; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/2/f" id="article-3-2-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>preparation of minutes of the meeting.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Standing orders for the regulation of any business of the Metropolitan Police Authority which, by reason of the urgency of that business, the clerk to that Authority considers it to be necessary or expedient to transact on or before the date of the first meeting of that Authority shall be prepared by the clerk to that Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article “the clerk to that Authority” means the person who is, by virtue of his appointment under section 407 of the 1999 Act, for the time being clerk to the Metropolitan Police Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 127 of the 1999 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> in its application to the Metropolitan Police Authority shall come into force on the operative date for the purposes only of articles 5 and 6 below.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 1999 Act, in so far as they are not already in force, shall come into force on the operative date for the purposes only of articles 5 and 6 below and for all other purposes shall come into force on 3rd July 2000:</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 310<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 26<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/4/2/c" id="article-4-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 62, 75 and 76 of Schedule 27.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The first meeting of the Metropolitan Police Authority may take place at any time after the operative date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph 6(1) of Schedule 2A to the 1996 Act and notwithstanding paragraph 6A of Schedule 12 to the Local Government Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> the first meeting of the Metropolitan Police Authority shall be regarded as that Authority’s annual meeting.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/5/3" id="article-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the first meeting takes place before 3rd July 2000, the provisions of article 6 below shall apply.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Arrangements shall be made by the clerk to the Metropolitan Police Authority for the public and the press to be admitted to the meeting.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No business shall be transacted at the meeting unless at least one quarter of the whole number of members of the Metropolitan Police Authority are present.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Arrangements may be made by the clerk to the Metropolitan Police Authority for the exclusion of a member of that Authority from the meeting while any contract, proposed contract, or other matter in which he has a pecuniary interest, direct or indirect, is under consideration.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/4" id="article-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Arrangements may be made at the meeting as to the matters specified in the Schedule to this Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5" id="article-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In addition to the matters specified in the Schedule to this Order the following powers may be exercised at the first meeting:</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/a" id="article-6-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the designation of a monitoring officer for the Metropolitan Police Authority in accordance with section 5(1) of the Local Government and Housing Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/b" id="article-6-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the appointment of a clerk to the Metropolitan Police Authority in accordance with section 16 of the 1996 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/c" id="article-6-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the appointment of a chief finance officer to the Metropolitan Police Authority in accordance with section 127(2) of the 1999 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/d" id="article-6-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the making of standing orders in accordance with paragraph 42 of Schedule 12 to the Local Government Act 1972;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/5/e" id="article-6-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the making of delegations in accordance with section 101 of the Local Government Act 1972.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/6" id="article-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Arrangements made or powers exercised in pursuance of this article shall be regarded as being made or exercised by the Metropolitan Police Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/6/7" id="article-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraphs (1) and (3) of this article “the clerk to the Metropolitan Police Authority” means the person who is, by virtue of his appointment under section 407 of the 1999 Act, for the time being the clerk to that Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Metropolitan Police Authority may make payments by way of reimbursement of expenses and allowances to members in accordance with paragraph 20 of Schedule 2A to the 1996 Act from the date of their appointment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1095/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1095/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In determining the period of a term of years for the purposes of paragraph 11 of Schedule 2A to the 1996 Act (term of appointment), any period prior to 3rd July 2000 shall be disregarded.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Section 1 of the Regional Development Agencies Act 1998 (“the Act”), so far as it relates to the establishment of a regional development agency for London, shall come into force on 3rd July 2000.

UK_uksi_2000_1173/c6196cdde8.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Regional Development Agencies Act 1998 (Commencement No. 2) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-04-29"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Regional Development Agencies Act 1998 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 2) Order 2000.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 1 of the Regional Development Agencies Act 1998 (“<Abbreviation Expansion="Regional Development Agencies Act 1998 c. 45">the Act</Abbreviation>”), so far as it relates to the establishment of a regional development agency for London, shall come into force on 3rd July 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of the London Development Agency—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 2 of the Act shall come into force on 8th May 2000 for the purpose only of enabling the Mayor to consult on the appointment of persons to be members of the Agency;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 6(1) and (2) of the Act, and section 6(6) so far as it relates to paragraph 1(1), paragraphs 2 to 10 and paragraph 13 of Schedule 3 to the Act, shall come into force on 8th May 2000; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1173/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 2 to 42 of the Act, in so far as they are not already in force, shall come into force on 3rd July 2000.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2000_2974/352cfcf175.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-11-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Utilities Act 2000 c. 27">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Utilities Act 2000;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Electricity Act 1989 c .29">Electricity Act</Abbreviation>” means the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas Act 1986 c. 44">Gas Act</Abbreviation>” means the Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 3 to 12, 7th November 2000 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas and Electricity Consumer Council">the Council</Abbreviation> pursuant to section 19(4)(a) objects to the disclosure of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from disclosing that information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 19(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from disclosing.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 19(4)(b).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in section 19(5) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electrical Supply”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 33DA of the Gas Act (which section 20(5) inserts into that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6 for “gas transporters” or “transporters” in all places where the words occur there is substituted “public gas transporters”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 42AA of the Electricity Act (which section 20(6) inserts into that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 38(4) of Schedule 6, the duty of the Council to publish information relating to complaints shall relate to complaints made by consumers about any matter relating to the activities of public electricity suppliers (as defined in section 6(9) of the Electricity Act) and the holders of a licence granted under section 6(2)(a) of the Electricity Act and “complaints” in section 42AA(2) of the Electricity Act shall be construed accordingly; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by the Council pursuant to section 21(4)(a) objects to the publication of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from publishing that information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 21(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from publishing.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragaphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 21(4)(b).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 32 of the Gas Act (which section 22(1) substitutes for the original section 32 of that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/a" id="article-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 95 for any purpose which includes the exercise by the Authority of its powers under section 30A(1) of the Gas Act (which section 95 inserts into that Act), there is omitted from the definition of “enforcement function” in subsection (10) “or 30A”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/b" id="article-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” in each place where it appears there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 46 of the Electricity Act (which section 22(2) substitutes for the original section 46 of that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/a" id="article-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 59 for any purpose which includes the exercise by the Authority of its powers under section 27A(1) of the Electricity Act (which section 59 inserts into that Act), there is omitted from the definition of “enforcement function” in subsection (10) “or 27A”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>

The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000. 2 In this Order— “the Act” means the Utilities Act 2000; “the Electricity Act” means the Electricity Act 1989; and “the Gas Act” means the Gas Act 1986. 3 In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act. 2 Subject to articles 3 to 12, 7th November 2000 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column. 3 1 Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by the Council pursuant to section 19(4)(a) objects to the disclosure of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from disclosing that information. 2 On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 19(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from disclosing. 3 For the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 19(4)(b). 4 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in section 19(5) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electrical Supply”. 4 In section 33DA of the Gas Act (which section 20(5) inserts into that Act)— a until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6 for “gas transporters” or “transporters” in all places where the words occur there is substituted “public gas transporters”; and b until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”. 5 In section 42AA of the Electricity Act (which section 20(6) inserts into that Act)— a until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 38(4) of Schedule 6, the duty of the Council to publish information relating to complaints shall relate to complaints made by consumers about any matter relating to the activities of public electricity suppliers (as defined in section 6(9) of the Electricity Act) and the holders of a licence granted under section 6(2)(a) of the Electricity Act and “complaints” in section 42AA(2) of the Electricity Act shall be construed accordingly; and b until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”. 6 1 Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by the Council pursuant to section 21(4)(a) objects to the publication of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from publishing that information. 2 On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 21(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from publishing. 3 For the purposes of paragaphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 21(4)(b). 10 1 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in sections 105(3)(a) and 105(8)(c) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electricity Supply” and in section 105(11) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply or the Director General of Electricity Supply”. 2 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 29(2) of Schedule 6, in section 105(3)(b) there is omitted “or section 28(2A) of the 1989 Act”. 3 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6, in relation to section 48 of the Gas Act, in section 105(10) in the definition of “relevant activities” for “gas transporter” there is substituted “public gas transporter”. 11 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 31 of Schedule 7— a in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply”; and b in sub-paragraph (5) there is omitted “the Authority and”, for “them” there is substituted “it” and for “their” there is substituted “its”. 12 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 32 of Schedule 7— a in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Electricity Supply”; and b in sub-paragraph (5) there is omitted “the Authority and”, for “them” there is substituted “it” and for “their” there is substituted “its”. </P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in section 33 of the Gas Act (which section 23(1) substitutes for the original section 33 of that Act) and in section 46A of the Electricity Act (which section 23(2) inserts into that Act) for “Authority” in all places where it occurs there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/1" id="article-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in sections 105(3)(a) and 105(8)(c) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electricity Supply” and in section 105(11) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply or the Director General of Electricity Supply”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/2" id="article-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 29(2) of Schedule 6, in section 105(3)(b) there is omitted “or section 28(2A) of the 1989 Act”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/3" id="article-10-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6, in relation to section 48 of the Gas Act, in section 105(10) in the definition of “relevant activities” for “gas transporter” there is substituted “public gas transporter”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 31 of Schedule 7—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/a" id="article-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/b" id="article-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5) there is omitted “the Authority and”, for “them” there is substituted “it” and for “their” there is substituted “its”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 32 of Schedule 7—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/a" id="article-12-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Electricity Supply”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/b" id="article-12-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5) there is omitted “the Authority and”, for “them” there is substituted “it” and for “their” there is substituted “its”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2000_3280/303ef9c36e.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Access to Justice Act 1999 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-12-13"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Access to Justice Act 1999 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000 and shall come into force on the day following that on which it is made.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Access to Justice Act 1999 shall come into force on 8th January 2001:</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the extent that it is not already in force, section 67(2);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 92 to 95 inclusive;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part V of Schedule 15 (repeals), the entries in the table headed “(8) Warrants” relating to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/i" id="article-2-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 125(2) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/ii" id="article-2-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 65 of the Criminal Justice Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/2/c/iii" id="article-2-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph 11 of Schedule 17 to the Courts and Legal Services Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>and, so far as it relates to those entries, section 106.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This paragraph applies where—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a warrant of arrest, commitment, detention or distress is issued by a justice of the peace at any time before 8th January 2001,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the warrant has not been executed before 8th January 2001, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/1/c" id="article-3-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if the warrant had been issued on 8th January 2001, section 125A(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 would have applied to it.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where paragraph (1) applies, the warrant may be executed on or after 8th January 2001 in the same manner as if it had been issued on 8th January 2001, and sections 125A and 125B of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 shall apply accordingly.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where paragraph (1) applies, the warrant need not be executed by a police officer, and may be executed by any person within the descriptions contained in section 125A(2) or 125B(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980, subject to and in accordance with any rules made under section 144 of that Act and for the time being in force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3280/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where paragraph (1) applies, basic personal information may be supplied as provided in section 125C of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 for the purpose of facilitating the enforcement of the warrant as if it had been issued on 8th January 2001.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Until the appointed day for the coming into force for all remaining purposes of section 51(2) and Schedule 4, Schedule 6 to the Electricity Act (as that Schedule had effect on the passing of the Act) shall continue to have effect as if section 51(2) had not come into force.

UK_uksi_2000_3343/8419ea61a2.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-12-19"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Utilities Act 2000 c. 27">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Utilities Act 2000;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Electricity Act 1989 c .29">Electricity Act</Abbreviation>” means the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas Act 1986 c. 44">Gas Act</Abbreviation>” means the Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force for all remaining purposes of section 51(2) and Schedule 4, Schedule 6 to the Electricity Act (as that Schedule had effect on the passing of the Act) shall continue to have effect as if section 51(2) had not come into force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1" id="article-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing exercise by the Authority of either the functions assigned to it by section 36A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> of the Gas Act or functions which it exercises concurrently with the Director General of Fair Trading by virtue of section 43(3)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> of the Electricity Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/a" id="article-10-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Authority shall exercise its functions as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/b" id="article-10-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 4B(3) of the Gas Act (which section 12 inserts into that Act) and section 3D(4) of the Electricity Act (which section 16 inserts into that Act) shall have no effect.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/2" id="article-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article “continuing exercise” means any exercise of the functions described in paragraph (1) which has been commenced but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/1" id="article-11-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing modification reference made to the Competition Commission under section 24<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> of the Gas Act or section 12<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> of the Electricity Act the Competition Commission shall exercise its functions under sections 24 and 25<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/> of the Gas Act or sections 12 and 13<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> of the Electricity Act in respect of the investigation of and report on that reference and the Authority shall exercise its functions in respect of the receipt of any report on that reference (under section 25 of the Gas Act or section 13 of the Electricity Act) and any modification of the conditions of any licence following such a report (where such modification is made pursuant to section 26<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> of the Gas Act or section 14<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> of the Electricity Act) as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A of the Gas Act and section 3 of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/2" id="article-11-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article a “continuing modification reference” means one which has been made to the Competition Commission before 20th December 2000 but on which either the Commission has not reported before 20th December 2000 or, the Commisson having reported, the Director General of Gas Supply or Director General of Electricity Supply has not before 20th December 2000 concluded the exercise of his functions under section 26 of the Gas Act (in the case of the Director General of Gas Supply) or section 14 of the Electricity Act (in the case of the Director General of Electricity Supply).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/1" id="article-12-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing application which is either a request for the revocation of a licence or has been made under sections 7B(1)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/> or 8AA<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/> of the Gas Act or section 6(3) of the Electricity Act, the Secretary of State and the Authority shall exercise their functions in respect of such an application as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/2" id="article-12-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article, a “continuing application” means one which has been made but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/13" id="article-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/1" id="article-13-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing proposal which has been made under either sections 23<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/> or 29(1)(a) of the Gas Act or sections 11 or 26(1)(a) of the Electricity Act, the Authority shall exercise its functions in respect of such a proposal as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/2" id="article-13-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article a “continuing proposal” means one which has been made but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/14" id="article-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/1" id="article-14-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing dispute which has been referred under section 27A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00018"/> of the Gas Act to the Director General of Gas Supply, the Authority (which for the purposes of this article includes any arbitrator or arbiter appointed pursuant to section 27A(1)(b) of the Gas Act) shall exercise its functions in respect of such a dispute as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A of the Gas Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/2" id="article-14-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article “continuing dispute” means one which has been referred to the Director General of Gas Supply but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/15" id="article-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/1" id="article-15-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any outstanding request which has been made (in the case of the Gas Act) in accordance with a licence condition imposed under section 7B of that Act either to the Director General of Gas Supply or the Secretary of State for a determination of such questions arising under the licence, or under any document specified or described in the licence, as are specified in the licence or are of a description so specified or for designation, acceptance or approval by the said Director General or Secretary of State or (in the case of the Electricity Act) in accordance with a licence condition imposed under section 7 of that Act to the Director General of Electricity Supply for a determination of such questions arising under the licence as are specified in the licence or are of a description so specified or for approval by the said Director General of such things falling to be done under the licence, and such contracts or agreements made before the grant of the licence as are specified in the licence or are of a description so specified, the Authority or, as the case may be, the Secretary of State shall exercise its functions in the case of such a request as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>

The Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No. 2, Transitional and Transitory Provisions) Order 2003 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No. 2, Transitional and Transitory Provisions) Order 2003. 2 In this Order— “the Act” means the Enterprise Act 2002; “appeal tribunal” means an appeal tribunal of the Competition Commission; “existing appeal” means an appeal made to the Competition Commission under section 46 or 47 of the Competition Act 1998 or regulation 25 or 26 of the EC Competition Law (Articles 84 and 85) Enforcement Regulations 2001 which has not been finally determined before 1st April 2003; and “the Tribunal” means the Competition Appeal Tribunal. 3 In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act. 2 1st April 2003 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column. 3 1 Any existing appeal shall be deemed to have been made to the Tribunal and shall continue as an appeal to the Tribunal and anything having any continuing effect done in relation to an existing appeal (including anything done for the purpose of an appeal from a decision made in relation to an existing appeal and anything done in connection with a request for a preliminary ruling of the Court of Justice of the European Communities in relation to an existing appeal) shall be deemed for all purposes to have been done in relation to an appeal to the Tribunal and is not to be invalidated by the commencement of any of the provisions brought into force by this Order. 2 Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), for the purposes of any existing appeal, anything done by the President of the Competition Commission Appeal Tribunals, the Registrar of Appeal Tribunals, and an appeal tribunal shall be deemed for all purposes to have been done by the President of the Competition Appeal Tribunal, the Registrar of the Competition Appeal Tribunal, and the Tribunal, respectively, and the members of any tribunal constituted by the President of the Competition Commission Appeal Tribunals in relation to an existing appeal in accordance with paragraph 27 of Schedule 7 to the Competition Act 1998 shall be treated as being the members of the Tribunal constituted in accordance with section 14 of the Act for the purposes of the relevant appeal. <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (Commencement No.5) Order 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order references to sections, Parts and Schedules are references to sections and Parts of, and Schedules to, <Abbreviation Expansion="Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 c. 37">the Act</Abbreviation>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/1/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order applies in relation to England only<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>19th September 2004 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/a" id="article-2-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 2 (rights of public in relation to access land) in so far as it relates to any access land—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/a/i" id="article-2-1-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is access land by virtue of section 1(1)(a) or (b); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/a/ii" id="article-2-1-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which lies within an area covered by one of the maps in conclusive form issued by the Countryside Agency for the purposes of Part I on 4th May 2004 and 2nd June 2004;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/b" id="article-2-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 (effect of right of access on rights and liabilities of owners);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/c" id="article-2-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 13 (occupiers' liability);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/d" id="article-2-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 14 (offence of displaying on access land notices deterring public use);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/e" id="article-2-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 18 (wardens);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/f" id="article-2-1-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 20 (codes of conduct and other information);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/g" id="article-2-1-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 46(3) (which introduces Schedule 4) in so far as it relates to the provisions in Schedule 4 referred to in sub-paragraph (i) below;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/h" id="article-2-1-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 2 (restrictions to be observed by persons exercising right of access); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/i" id="article-2-1-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 2 (amendment to the Forestry Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>) and 3 (amendment to the Agriculture Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>) of Schedule 4.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of section 2 in so far as it relates to any access land—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/i" id="article-2-2-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is access land solely by virtue of section 1(1)(e); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/ii" id="article-2-2-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which lies within an area covered by one of the maps in conclusive form referred to in paragraph (1)(a)(ii) above,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>is 19th September 2004 or the end of a period of six months beginning with the day on which the land is dedicated for the purposes of Part I under section 16 (dedication of land as access land), whichever is the later.</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">

<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire Services Act 1947 c. 41">1947 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire Services Act 1947<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 c. 21">2004 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>So far as it enables an order to be made under section 19 (charging), section 21 (Fire and Rescue National Framework) and section 36 (preservation of existing pension scheme), the 2004 Act shall come into force on 7th September 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to article 3 the 2004 Act shall, insofar as it is not already in force, come into force on 1st October 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where, before 1st October 2004, a fire authority provides a service to another person or contracts to provide such a service in exercise of its powers under sections 3(1)(e) or 3(4A) of the 1947 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, any charges which relate to the provision of that service shall be treated as payable under the 1947 Act, notwithstanding the repeal of the 1947 Act by the 2004 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (3) applies where—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before 1st October 2004, an order is made under section 95 of the Local Government Act 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> authorising specified fire and rescue authorities to provide for a commercial purpose any specified service; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a specified fire and rescue authority provides, or contracts to provide, a specified service on or before 31st March 2005.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this paragraph applies, any charge which relates to the provision of a specified service shall be treated as payable under the 1947 Act, notwithstanding the repeal of the 1947 Act by the 2004 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

act.title: Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act

unit.text: Subject to paragraph (3), 1st April 2004 is the appointed day for the coming into force of sections 48, 49, 50(1) and (5), 51(1) to (3), (5) and (6), 52(1) to (4), (6) and (7), 53 to 57, 60, 61, 64 to 68, 103, 106, 124, 126, 128, 130, 132, 134, 136 to 138, and 140 insofar as they are not already in force.

UK_uksi_2004_759/409029688c.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 Commencement (No.3) Order 2004</dc:title><Made Date="2004-03-09"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 Commencement (No.3) Order 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="National Health Service Act 1977 c. 49">1977 Act</Abbreviation>” means the National Health Service Act 1977<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 c. 43">2003 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“excepted <Acronym Expansion="National Health Service">NHS</Acronym> trust” means —the Oxford Learning Disability National Health Service Trust<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;the Calderstones National Health Service Trust<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;the Northgate and Prudhoe National Health Service Trust<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order applies to England and Wales, except for Articles 4 and 10, which apply to England only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>1st April 2004 is the appointed day for the coming into force of sections 1, 5 to 20, 22 to 35, and 37 to 39 of, and Schedules 1 and 3 to 5, to the 2003 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (3), 1st April 2004 is the appointed day for the coming into force of sections 48, 49, 50(1) and (5), 51(1) to (3), (5) and (6), 52(1) to (4), (6) and (7), 53 to 57, 60, 61, 64 to 68, 103, 106, 124, 126, 128, 130, 132, 134, 136 to 138, and 140 insofar as they are not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
