<Text>During the period from 1<Superior>st</Superior> July 2005 to 31<Superior>st</Superior> March 2006 the amendments made by section 104(3), (4) and (6) of the Act are to have effect so that the reference in sections 330(4)(b), 331(4) and 332(4) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, as substituted by section 104 of the Act, to the Director General of the Serious Organised Crime Agency is to have effect as a reference to the Director General of the National Criminal Intelligence Service.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1521/article/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1521/article/3/5" id="article-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The references in section 133(2) (notice of demonstrations in designated area) of the Act to a demonstration starting are to take effect as if they were references to demonstrations starting or continuing on or after 1<Superior>st</Superior> August 2005.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Section 197(9) and Part 1 of Schedule 23, in so far as they relate to the repeal of section 28(3)(b) of the Utilities Act 2000, shall come into force— a

UK_uksi_2005_2965/69cb47bc14.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Energy Act 2004 (Commencement No. 6) Order 2005</dc:title><Made Date="2005-10-17"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Energy Act 2004 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6) Order 2005.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Energy Act 2004 c. 20">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Energy Act 2004;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“adjustment formula” means a formula under which the price of electricity is adjusted having regard to the current market price of some other commodity;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“affiliate”, in relation to a body corporate that is the owner or operator of a generating station, means a subsidiary or holding company of that body corporate and any subsidiary or holding company of such holding company (and, for the purposes of this definition, “subsidiary” and “holding company” have the meanings ascribed to them in section 736 of the Companies Act 1985<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“applicable turnover” means the amounts, ascertained in conformity with normal accounting practice in Great Britain, which are—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>derived by a high electricity user from the provision of goods and services within that person’s ordinary activities; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>computed on an accruals basis so that the amounts referred to in paragraph (a) relating to the period for which applicable turnover is being determined are taken into account, without regard to the date of invoice or receipt of payment,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>after deduction of value added tax and any other taxes based on such amounts;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“connected person”, in relation to an owner or operator of a generating station, means a person connected to him within the meaning of section 839 of the Income and Corporation Taxes Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“distribution system” and “transmission system” have the meaning that those terms bear in the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“high electricity user” means a body corporate which, for each year since the commencement of a long term, fixed-price contract under which electricity is supplied to it, has spent in excess of twenty per cent of its applicable turnover on electricity, and which receives under that contract at least ninety per cent of all the electricity which it receives;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“long term, fixed-price contract” means a contract entered into before 1st April 2002 which is still in force on the date this Order is made, and which provides for an electricity generator (or a person who is a connected person or an affiliate in relation to an electricity generator) to provide a specified amount (or a specified maximum amount) of electricity to a specified consumer at a price which is specified either numerically or by reference to an adjustment formula; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“stand-by electricity” means electricity conveyed temporarily, periodically or intermittently to make good any unplanned shortfall in the availability of electricity to the recipient for its own consumption from a generating station owned or operated by the recipient or by a person who is a connected person or an affiliate in relation to the recipient, where such shortfall arises from that generating station being wholly or partly out of commission for a temporary period.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 177 of the Act shall come into force on 1st November 2005.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Except for the purposes mentioned in paragraph (2), section 179 of the Act shall come into force on 1st April 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 179 shall come into force on 1st April 2010—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of sections 32 to 32C of the Electricity Act 1989, in respect of any electricity which (without being conveyed to the premises wholly or partly by means of a distribution system) is supplied to premises occupied by a high electricity user from a substation to which it has been conveyed by means of a transmission system; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in respect of any electricity which, being stand-by electricity, is supplied (without being conveyed to the premises wholly or partly by means of a distribution system) to premises occupied by a body corporate from a substation to which it has been conveyed by means of a transmission system.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 197(9) and Part 1 of Schedule 23, in so far as they relate to the repeal of section 28(3)(b) of the Utilities Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, shall come into force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on 1st April 2006 except for the purposes mentioned in article 3(2); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on 1st April 2010 for those purposes.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (Commencement No.11 and Savings) Order 2006</dc:title><Made Date="2006-04-18"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/1" id="article-1">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 11 and Savings) Order 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 c. 37">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 c. 69">1981 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the appointed day” means the day appointed under article 2;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant order” has the meaning given in section 48(10) of the Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>

</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/1/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order applies in relation to England only<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>2nd May 2006 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 47 (redesignation of roads used as public paths);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 48 (restricted byway rights);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 49 (provisions supplementary to sections 47 and 48);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 50 (private rights over restricted byways);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/e" id="article-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 51 (which gives effect to Schedule 5) insofar as it relates to the provisions of Schedule 5 mentioned in paragraph (g) below;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/f" id="article-2-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 102 (which gives effect to Schedule 16) insofar as it relates to the entry in Part II of Schedule 16 referring to section 54 of the 1981 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 (amendments relating to definitive maps and statements and restricted byways)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/i" id="article-2-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph 1;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/ii" id="article-2-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 6 and 7;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/iii" id="article-2-g-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph 9; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/iv" id="article-2-g-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 12 to 17.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in sections 47 or 48 of the Act shall affect the operation of section 53 or 54 of, or Schedule 14 or 15 to, the 1981 Act in relation to—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a relevant order made before the appointed day; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">

<P3para>
<Text>an application made before the appointed day for a relevant order.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In particular, where, before the appointed day, a surveying authority has made a relevant order under section 54 of the 1981 Act, but that order has not yet come into operation—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">

<P3para>
<Text>the order shall continue to have effect on and after the appointed day, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">

<P3para>
<Text>the provisions of Schedule 15 to the 1981 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> shall continue to have effect in relation to the order,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>as if section 54 had not been repealed.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Text>This Order may be cited as the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 2) (England) Order 2006.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1361/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1361/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1361/article/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1361/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2), section 104 of, and Part 10 of Schedule 5 to, the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 come into force on 4th August 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1361/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1361/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (1) applies only in so far as the provisions to which it refers make amendments to section 78L of the Environmental Protection Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> which relate to appeals against remediation notices served by a local authority in England or by the Environment Agency in relation to land in England.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 105(3) to (5) and (7) of the Act; and</Text>

</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>

<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 113(1), (3) and (4) (complaints about health care);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">

<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 12(2), 15(3), 16(3) and 22(7)(i) of the 2000 Act shall be read as if—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/2/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/2/i" id="article-4-2-i">

<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after “the Assembly” there were inserted “or the CSCI”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1680/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 15(5) of the 2000 Act shall be read as if after “the Assembly” there were inserted “or the CSCI”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/iv" id="article-5-c-iv">

</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/v" id="article-5-c-v">

</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/d" id="article-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 80(2) in so far as it relates to the repeals or revocations specified in paragraph (c).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Notwithstanding the substitution, except so far as relating to Welsh NHS bodies, of section 98 of the 1977 Act by section 56 of the Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 98 of the 1977 Act;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b" id="article-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the following provisions of the Audit Commission Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/i" id="article-6-1-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 5(1)(a);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/ii" id="article-6-1-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “health service body” in section 53(1);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/iii" id="article-6-1-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 1(e) and (g), 1A and 1C of Schedule 2;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/c" id="article-6-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 144(2) of the Government of Wales Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/d" id="article-6-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 14 of the Government Resources and Accounts Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/e" id="article-6-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>article 2(1) of the Special Health Authorities (Audit) Order 2006,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<Text>as in force on 30th September 2006 shall apply as regards accounts kept by the bodies listed in section 98(1) in relation to the financial year ending 31st March 2007 (accordingly, the arrangements set out in the new Schedule 12B of the 1977 Act shall apply in relation to each subsequent financial year) and as regards outstanding matters relating to earlier financial years.</Text>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(a), section 98(4) of the 1977 Act (as it continues in effect by virtue of paragraph (1)(a)) shall not apply in relation to any Special Health Authority in relation to the financial year ending 31st March 2007</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraphs (1) and (2) have no effect in relation to Welsh NHS bodies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2007_3136/e9844c9315.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 (Commencement No. 1 and Savings) Order 2007</dc:title><Made Date="2007-10-31"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 1 and Savings) Order 2007, and shall apply in relation to local authorities in England only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 c. 28">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 1972 c. 70">1972 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 1992 c. 19">1992 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 3, the following provisions of the Act come into force on the day following the day on which this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 1 (structural and boundary change in England);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 1; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the entries in Part 1 of Schedule 18, and section 241 so far as relating to that Part of that Schedule.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 7(6) of the 1972 Act (elections of councillors)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, and orders<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> treated as made under section 17 of the 1992 Act (implementation of recommendations by order)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> by virtue of section 7(6), shall continue to have effect as though section 17 of the 1992 Act, and section 26 (orders <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> under Part 2) of that Act in so far as it applies in relation to section 17, were not amended by, respectively, paragraphs 6 and 10 of Schedule 1 to the Act, nor repealed (in part) by Part 1 of Schedule 18 to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments to, and repeals (in part) of sections 17 and 26 of the 1992 Act mentioned in paragraph (1) of this article shall not affect the continuing operation of—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>orders made by the Secretary of State for the purpose of giving effect (with or without modifications) to recommendations made by the Electoral Commission to the Secretary of State for structural or boundary changes<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>orders making incidental, consequential, supplementary or transitional provision for the purposes or in consequence of orders of the description mentioned in sub-paragraph (a)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A county council which, by the operation of section 18(1)(a) of the 1992 Act (consequences of structural changes etc.)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>, is a billing authority for the purposes of Part 1 of the Local Government Finance Act 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>, shall continue to enjoy that status and section 18 of the 1992 Act shall continue to apply in relation to that council as though it were not repealed by paragraph 7 of Schedule 1 and Part 1 of Schedule 18 to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the Local Government and Rating Act 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/a" id="article-3-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the references in sections 17(4) (electoral arrangements)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> and 20(2)(a) (election of parish councillors) to section 17 of the 1992 Act shall continue to have effect as though section 17 of the 1992 Act were not amended nor repealed (in part) as described in paragraph (1) of this article;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/b" id="article-3-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the definition of “structural change” in section 20(3) and the use of that expression in section 20(2) shall continue to have effect as though section 14 of the 1992 Act (changes that may be recommended)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> were not amended by paragraph 3 of Schedule 1 to the Act nor repealed (in part) by Part 1 of Schedule 18 to the Act;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/c" id="article-3-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the reference in section 23(9) (orders and regulations under Part 2) to section 20 of the 1992 Act shall continue to have effect as though section 20 were not repealed by paragraph 9 of Schedule 1 and Part 1 of Schedule 18 to the Act; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/4/d" id="article-3-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the amendments to and repeal (in part) of section 17 and the repeal of section 20 of the 1992 Act mentioned in this paragraph shall not affect the continuing operation of orders made under sections 14 (implementation by the Secretary of State), 16 (establishment of new parish councils), or 17 (electoral arrangements) of the Local Government and Rating Act 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/>.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/5" id="article-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect the continuing operation of regulations of general application made under section 19 of the 1992 Act (regulations for supplementing orders)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/> or section 15 of the 1997 Act (regulations for supplementing orders under section 14)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/6" id="article-3-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect the continuing validity of agreements made under section 20(1) of the 1992 Act (agreements as to incidental matters) between public bodies affected by orders under Part 2 of the 1992 Act, and section 20 of the 1992 Act shall continue to apply in relation to such agreements as though it were not repealed by paragraph 9 of Schedule 1 and Part 1 of Schedule 18 to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/3136/article/3/7" id="article-3-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect the continuing operation of Schedule 1 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 (assembly constituencies and orders under section 2(4))<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/>, and in particular, references in paragraph 1 of that Schedule to sections 13, 14, or 15 of the 1992 Act shall continue to have effect as though those sections were not amended by, respectively, paragraphs 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 1 nor repealed (in part) by Part 1 of Schedule 18 to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-deb33b"/>1</Pnumber>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/172/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/172/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">

<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 (Commencement No.2 and Savings) Order 2008.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/172/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/172/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">

<P2para>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007 c. 28">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government and Public Involvement in Health Act 2007;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 2000 c. 22">2000 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/172/article/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/172/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-f23484"/>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/172/article/9/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/172/article/9/1" id="article-9-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subsection (1) of section 202 of the Act (politically restricted posts: grant and supervision of exemptions) shall come into force on 1st April 2008.</Text>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Housing and Regeneration Act 2008 (Commencement No.6 and Transitional and Savings Provisions) Order 2009</dc:title><Made Date="2009-08-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Housing and Regeneration Act 2008 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional and Savings Provisions) Order 2009.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the 2008 Act” means the Housing and Regeneration Act 2008; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the commencement date” means 7th September 2009.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 114 of the 2008 Act (registration of local authorities), so far as not already in force, shall come into force, in relation to England, on the commencement date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 2008 Act shall come into force, in relation to England, on the commencement date, subject to article 3(1) and (2)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 300 (right to acquire freehold: abolition of low rent test);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 301 (shared ownership leases: protection for certain leases) and 302 (shared ownership leases: protection for hard to replace houses), in so far as they are not already in force; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>except as mentioned in section 325(2)(b) of the 2008 Act, section 321(1) (consequential amendments and repeals) and Schedule 16 (repeals and revocations), in so far as they relate to the repeal of such provisions of the 1967 Act as are listed in Schedule 16.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 316 of the 2008 Act (amendments to Housing Act 1985: lending institutions) shall come into force on the commencement date, subject to article 3(3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2), the amendments made in consequence of article 2(2)(a) and (c) shall not have effect as regards any long tenancy<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> within the meaning of Part 1 of the Leasehold Reform Act 1967 (enfranchisement and extension of long leaseholds)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>granted before the commencement date; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>granted after the commencement date but arising from a written agreement for the grant of that tenancy made before the commencement date.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 1AA of the Leasehold Reform Act 1967 (additional right to enfranchisement only in case of houses whose rent exceeds applicable limit under section 4)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> shall continue to have effect as regards a tenancy granted—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the commencement date; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in respect of a house that is within an area described in the Housing (Right to Enfranchise) (Designated Protected Areas) (England) Order 2009<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purpose of the application of that section the areas described in that Order shall be treated as areas designated as rural areas under subsection (3)(a) of that section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2009/2096/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made by section 316 of the 2008 Act shall not have effect for the purpose of defining “approved lending institutions” in sections 36(4), 151B(5) and 156(4) of the Housing Act 1985<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> where the advance concerned was made before the commencement date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Criminal Justice Act 2003 (Commencement No. 25) Order 2010</dc:title><Made Date="2010-12-16"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/3005/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/3005/article/1" id="article-1">

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 25) Order 2010.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/3005/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/3005/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Criminal Justice Act 2003 c. 44">2003 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Criminal Justice Act 2003.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/3005/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/3005/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 29(1) to (3), (5) and (6) (new method of instituting proceedings) and section 30 (further provision about the new method) of the 2003 Act come into force on 1st January 2011 but only for the purposes of—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/3005/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/3005/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>

<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: To the extent that it could have been made in a statutory instrument by the Welsh Ministers under section 5 of the Sea Fish (Conservation) Act 1967 and section 189 of the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009, byelaw 38 (maximum vessel size) of the South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee takes effect, with the omission of paragraph 3 of that byelaw, after article 3 comes into force as if made by the Welsh Ministers in a statutory instrument under those Acts in relation to the same area of Wales as the area to which that provision originally applied.

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009 (Commencement No. 1, Consequential, Transitional and Savings Provisions) (England and Wales) Order 2010</dc:title><Made Date="2010-03-08"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2" id="article-2">

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the 1966 Act” means the Sea Fisheries Regulation Act 1966<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the 2006 Regulations” means the Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“England” includes the sea adjacent to England to a distance of 12 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Menai Strait Fishery Order Management Association” means the Menai Strait Fishery Order Management Association (Company Registration Number 07163689);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries Committee” means the local fisheries committee for the North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries District referred to in the North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries District Order 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“relevant employee” has the meaning given in paragraph (2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee” means the local fisheries committee for the South Wales Sea Fisheries District created by Order of the Board of Agriculture and Fisheries on 27th June 1912<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the transfer date” means 1st April 2010; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Wales” has the meaning given by section 158(1) and (3) of the Government of Wales Act 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">

<Text>relates to any part of Wales; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/c" id="article-13-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>could have been made in a statutory instrument by the Welsh Ministers under any enactment other than the 1966 Act,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>takes effect after article 3 comes into force as if made by the Welsh Ministers in a statutory instrument under that other enactment in relation to the same area of Wales as the area to which that provision originally applied.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/5" id="article-13-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There may be continued by or in relation to the Welsh Ministers anything (including legal proceedings) which relates to any of the byelaws falling within paragraphs (1) to (4), and is in the process of being done immediately before article 3 comes into force to the extent that the Welsh Ministers could lawfully undertake or be involved in that action.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6" id="article-13-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Anything which was done by—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/a" id="article-13-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/b" id="article-13-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the North Western and North Wales Sea Fishery Committee; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/c" id="article-13-6-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Environment Agency, or its predecessors, whilst exercising the powers of a local fisheries committee,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>for the purpose of or in connection with any of the byelaws falling within paragraphs (1) to (4) and which is in effect immediately before the transfer date, has effect on and after the transfer date as if done by the Welsh Ministers to the extent that the Welsh Ministers could lawfully undertake or be involved in that action.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/7" id="article-13-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers are substituted for the Environment Agency, or its predecessors, in any instruments or contracts which are either made or commenced before the transfer date and which relate to any of the byelaws falling within paragraph (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) (England) Order 2011</dc:title><Made Date="2011-07-18"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No.<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1 and Transitional Provisions) (England) Order 2011.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order, “the 2010 Act” means the Flood and Water Management Act 2010.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 2010 Act come into force on 19th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>July 2011 in relation to England only—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 11 (effect of national and local strategies: England);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 18 (Environment Agency: reports);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 31 (amendment of other Acts), so far as it relates to the provisions of Schedule 2 commenced by this article;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 24 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Coast Protection Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 29, 30, 35, 36, 38 and 39 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Land Drainage Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/f" id="article-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 45 to 47 and 49 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Water Resources Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Despite the amendments made by paragraphs 1 to 24 of Schedule 2 to the 2010 Act, the provisions of the Coast Protection Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> as in force immediately before 19th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>July 2011 continue to apply to any coast protection work started before that date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Despite the amendment made by paragraph 30 of Schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2 to the 2010 Act, section 17 of the Land Drainage Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> continues to apply to a local authority for an area in England unless the lead local flood authority for that area has published a summary of its local flood risk management strategy under section 9(7) of the 2010 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“coast protection work” has the meaning given in section 49(1) of the Coast Protection Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> as in force immediately before 19th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>July 2011; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“local authority” has the meaning given in section 72(1) of the Land Drainage Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Criminal Justice Act 2003 (Commencement No. 26) Order 2011</dc:title><Made Date="2011-09-05"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/1" id="article-1" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2011-09-05">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-726df1"/>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 26) Order 2011.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Criminal Justice Act 2003 c. 44">2003 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Criminal Justice Act 2003.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/2" id="article-2" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2011-09-05">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-71d818"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 29(1) to (3), (5) and (6) (new method of instituting proceedings) and section 30 (further provision about the new method) of the 2003 Act come into force on the day following the day on which this Order is made but only for the purposes of criminal proceedings instituted by a public prosecutor specified in an Order made by the Secretary of State under section 29(5)(h) of the 2003 Act or a person authorised by such a person (specification of a person as a public prosecutor or a person authorised by such a person for the purposes of issuing a written charge and requisition).</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/3" id="article-3" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="2023-05-03"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-32b030"/>3</Pnumber><P1para><Text>Section 29(1) to (3), (5) and (6) (new method of instituting proceedings) and section 30 (further provision about the new method) of the 2003 Act come into force on 3rd October 2011, but only for the purposes of criminal proceedings instituted by a public prosecutor within the meaning of —</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/3/a" id="article-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>section 29(5)(a) of the 2003 Act (a police force or a person authorised by a police force to institute criminal proceedings), so far as not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2188/article/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2188/article/3/b" id="article-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>section 29(5)(e) of the 2003 Act (a Secretary of State or a person authorised by a Secretary of State to institute criminal proceedings) where criminal proceedings are instituted by  <Substitution ChangeId="key-2da981-1785929856075" CommentaryRef="key-2da981">the Secretary of State for Business and Trade</Substitution>   or a person authorised by that Secretary of State.</Text></P3para></P3></P1para></P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Despite the amendments made by paragraphs 1 to 24 of Schedule 2 to the 2010 Act, the provisions of the Coast Protection Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> as in force immediately before 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2011 in relation to Wales continue to apply to any coast protection work started in relation to Wales before that date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Despite the amendment made by paragraph 30 of Schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2 to the 2010 Act, section 17 of the Land Drainage Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> continues to apply to a local authority for an area in Wales unless the lead local flood authority for that area has published a summary of its local flood risk management strategy under section 10(7) of the 2010 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/3" id="article-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“coast protection work” has the meaning given in section 49(1) of the Coast Protection Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1949 as in force immediately before 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2011 in relation to Wales; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“local authority” has the meaning given in section 72(1) of the Land Drainage Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P1para>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No.1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2011.</Text>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act come into force the day after the day this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 8(2);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 15;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 19;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 20 for the purposes of enabling the Secretary of State to make an order under section 15;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/e" id="article-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 21 and Schedule 2, to the extent that the provisions inserted into the Local Government Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> by that section and Schedule enable the Secretary of State to make regulations or orders;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/f" id="article-2-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 69(8);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/h" id="article-2-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 70 of Schedule 3 and section 22 so far as relating to that paragraph;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/2/i" id="article-2-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedules 5 to 7.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In relation to the financial year beginning on 1st April 2012, the reference in section 52ZC(3)(b) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> to an authority’s relevant basic amount of council for the financial year immediately preceding the year under consideration is a reference to the amount calculated for the authority and that financial year in accordance with section 52ZX of that Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> as modified by paragraph (2) below.</Text>

</P2>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (2), for “section 42B(1) above” substitute “section 44(1) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (3), for “section 42B(1) above if section 42A above” substitute “section 44(1) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 if section 43 of that Act”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/d" id="article-3-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (5)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2896/article/3/2/d/i" id="article-3-2-d-i">

<P4para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/f" id="article-4-1-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 37 (civil sanctions);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/g" id="article-4-1-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 15 and 16 of Schedule 1, so far as those provisions provide power for the Minister, as defined in paragraph 17 of that Schedule, to make regulations;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/h" id="article-4-1-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 17 of Schedule 1;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/i" id="article-4-1-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 37 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Land Drainage Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/j" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/4/1/j" id="article-4-1-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 54 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Local Government Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>), so far as not already commenced.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/694/article/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/5" id="article-5"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef repeal of Schedule 5 to the Environment Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1995 (“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Environment Act 1995 c. 25">1995 Act</Abbreviation>”) by paragraph 53 of IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/694/article/5/2/a" id="article-5-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any payment, or arrangement for payment, under paragraph 10 of Schedule 5 to the 1995<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>Act of a pension by the Agency <Addition ChangeId="key-c7df45-1787932848347" CommentaryRef="key-c7df45">in relation to English Committees or the Natural Resources Body for Wales in relation to Welsh Committees</Addition>  to a person who has been or, on 31st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>March 2011, is the chairman of a regional flood defence
