<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-04-03"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Localism Act 2011 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 5 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) Order 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Localism Act 2011 c. 20">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Localism Act 2011;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Greater London Authority Act 1999 c. 29">1999 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Greater London Authority Act 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 2000 c. 22">2000 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 7 and 8, the following provisions of the Act come into force in relation to England and Wales the day after the day on which this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 1(7);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 1;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 14;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 1 of Schedule 25 and section 237 so far as it relates to that Part.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 7, 9, 10 and 11, the following provisions of the Act come into force in relation to England and Wales on 3rd May 2012—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 188;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 192;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 225 to 229;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 231;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 23;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/3/f" id="article-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 33 of Schedule 25 and section 237 so far as it relates to that Part.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act (so far as they are not yet in force) come into force in relation to England and Wales on 4th May 2012—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 21 and 22;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedules 2 and 3;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/4/c" id="article-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 4 of Schedule 25 and section 237 so far as it relates to that Part.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Sections 48 to 57 of the Act come into force in relation to England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland on 31st May 2012</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 150(3) of the Act comes into force in relation to England and Wales on 15th January 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following transitional, transitory and savings provisions have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/1" id="article-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The amendment of section 2(1) of the 2000 Act by paragraphs 2 and 3 of Schedule 1 to the Act shall take effect subject to the following.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2" id="article-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A parish council that is an eligible parish council<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> for the purposes of Part 1 of the 2000 Act at the time of the coming into force of Schedule 1 shall continue to be able to exercise the power under section 2 of the 2000 Act (power to promote well-being)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/a" id="article-8-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where eligible by virtue of article 4 of the Parish Councils (Power to Promote Well-being) (Prescribed Conditions) Order 2008 (transitional provisions), in accordance with that article;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/b" id="article-8-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where otherwise eligible, until the end of the day of its next annual meeting in a year of ordinary elections and after that day for the purpose of completing any activity—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/b/i" id="article-8-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>undertaken in the exercise of section 2 of the 2000 Act, but</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/2/b/ii" id="article-8-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>not completed before the day of the meeting.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/8/3" id="article-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The power under section 2 of the 2000 Act shall remain a function of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, and the constituent councils of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority shall continue to have the power under that section to the extent necessary for it to be a function of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/9/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/9/1" id="article-9-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>On the day on which section 333F of the 1999 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> comes into force, the Economic development strategy for London is to consist of the London Development Agency strategy mentioned in paragraph (b) of section 41(1) of the 1999 Act which has been prepared and published before that day.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/9/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/9/2" id="article-9-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The duties on the Mayor of London imposed by section 333F(1) to (3) of the 1999 Act are deemed to be satisfied in relation to that strategy by the provisions of this article.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/1" id="article-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>On the day on which section 351A of the 1999 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> comes into force, the London Environment Strategy is to consist of the strategies mentioned in paragraphs (d) to (g) of section 41(1) of the 1999 Act which have been prepared and published before that day.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/2" id="article-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The duties on the Mayor of London imposed by section 351A(1) to (4) of the 1999 Act are deemed to be satisfied in relation to that Strategy by the provisions of this article.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/10/3" id="article-10-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any guidance or direction given under powers in the 1999 Act repealed by Schedule 23 to the Act which is applicable in relation to any of the strategies specified in the paragraphs referred to in paragraph (1), remains effective as guidance or a direction in relation to the relevant part of the London Environment Strategy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 42B<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> of the 1999 Act does not apply in relation to the draft revision of the London housing strategy which was published for consultation in December 2011.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1008/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1008/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where, on or before 14th January 2013, a local housing authority has published its tenancy strategy under section 150(1) of the Act, it must have regard to that strategy in exercising its housing management functions.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Health and Social Care Act 2012 (Commencement No.1 and Transitory Provision) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-05-17"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1319/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1319/article/1" id="article-1">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1319/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1319/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1319/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1319/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>

<P2para><Text>Insofar as they are not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, the following provisions of the Act shall come into force in accordance with this Order.</Text>

<Para>
<Text>section 8 (Secretary of State’s duty as to reporting on and reviewing treatment of providers);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 64(3) to (5) (supplementary provision as to Monitor’s general duties), and section 64(1) insofar as it relates to those subsections, only insofar as section 64(1) and (3) to (5) relate to section 8 of the Act;</Text>

</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 299 (certificate of consent of community patients to treatment).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1319/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1319/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 39 (discharge of patients);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 42 (transfers to and from special hospitals);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 44 (patients’ correspondence);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 59 (repeal of <Acronym Expansion="Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome">AIDS</Acronym> (Control) Act 1987);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 61(1) (Monitor);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 64(3) to (5) (supplementary provision as to Monitor’s general duties), and section 64(1) insofar as it relates to those subsections, insofar as they are not already in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 79 (mergers involving <Acronym Expansion="National Health Service">NHS</Acronym> foundation trusts);</Text>

</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 160 (bodies which may apply for foundation trust status);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 201 (disclosure of reports <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation> by the Health Service Commissioner);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 207(8) and (10) (control of entry on pharmaceutical lists);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 227 (appointments to regulatory bodies);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 231 and Part 4 of Schedule 15 (abolition of the Office of the Health Professions Adjudicator);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 278 and Part 1 of Schedule 20 (abolition of the Alcohol Education and Research Council);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 283 (standing advisory committees);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 288(1) and (2)(a) (Monitor: duty to co-operate with Care Quality Commission);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 289(2), and section 289(1) insofar as it relates to that subsection (Care Quality Commission: duty to co-operate with Monitor);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 289(3) insofar as it omits the whole of section 70(2) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, and insofar as it substitutes section 70(2)(a) of that Act, and section 289(1) insofar as it relates to section 289(3);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 289(4)(a) and (6), and section 289(1) insofar as it relates to those subsections;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 300 to 302 and Schedules 22 and 23 (transfer schemes), except insofar as they relate to—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the National Health Service Commissioning Board,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>a clinical commissioning group,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any person with whom the Secretary of State has made, or has decided to make, an agreement under section 12ZA(1) of the Mental Health Act 1983,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (established under section 232 of the Act), and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the Health and Social Care Information Centre (established under section 252 of the Act);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in Schedule 4, paragraphs 112 and 115 (consequential amendments of the National Health Service Act 2006 in relation to transfer schemes), and section 55(1) insofar as it relates to those paragraphs;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in Schedule 6, paragraph 2(1) (modification of requirements as to consultation), and paragraph 1(4) of that Schedule (interpretation) and section 55(3) (amendments related to Part 1 and transitional provision) insofar as they relate to that paragraph;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in Schedule 13 (minor and consequential amendments in relation to Part 3 of the Act)—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 7,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>paragraph 9(1) only insofar as it omits section 31(1) of the National Health Service Act 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>paragraphs 11 to 13,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>paragraph 8 insofar as it relates to paragraphs 9, 11 and 12, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>paragraphs 18 and 19,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
<Text>and section 150(5) insofar as it relates to those paragraphs.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1319/article/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1319/article/2/4" id="article-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>1st August 2012 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Act—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 209 to 211 (power to regulate social workers etc. in England and orders under section 60 of the Health Act 1999);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 212(2) and (3) (abolition of the General Social Care Council);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 213 to 218 (the Health and Care Professions Council);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 220 (references in enactments to registered health professionals, etc.);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 221 (functions of the Secretary of State in relation to social care workers);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 223(1), (2), (5), (9), (10) and (14) (functions of the Professional Standards Authority for Health and Social Care);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 230, except insofar as subsection (1) relates to Part 3 of Schedule 15, and Parts 1 and 2 of Schedule 15 (consequential provisions and savings, etc. in relation to Part 7 of the Act).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1319/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1319/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>From 1st July 2012 until section 222 of the Act (the Professional Standards Authority for Health and Social Care) comes into force, the references to the Professional Standards Authority for Health and Social Care in section 25C of the National Health Service Reform and Health Care Professions Act 2002<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> are to be read as references to the Council for Healthcare Regulatory Excellence.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">

</Para>

<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 2000 c. 22">2000 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>

</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-375613"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act (so far as they are not yet in force) come into force in relation to England and Wales on the day after the day on which this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 27, except paragraph (k) of subsection (6), so far as it enables a relevant authority to adopt a code of conduct which will take effect on or after 1st July 2012;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 28 so far as it enables a relevant authority to make arrangements under which allegations can be investigated on or after 1st July 2012;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 29 so far as it enables a monitoring officer of a relevant authority to prepare a register of interests which will take effect on or after 1st July 2012;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 31(10) so far as it enables a relevant authority to make standing orders that will take effect on or after 1st July 2012;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/e" id="article-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 33 so far as it enables a relevant authority to grant a dispensation which will take effect on or after 1st July 2012;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/f" id="article-2-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 35;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 153;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/h" id="article-2-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 4, paragraphs 13(1), (2) and 31 so far as they repeal provisions which enable regulations to enable a standards committee of a relevant authority to suspend or partially suspend a person from being a member or co-opted member of the authority, and section 26 so far as it relates to those provisions;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/2/i" id="article-2-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 31 of Schedule 25 and section 237 so far as relating to that Part.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-484bab"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Sections 145 to 147 of the Act (so far as they are not yet in force) come into force in relation to England and Wales on 18th June 2012.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-fed1aa"/>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Sections 81 to 85 of the Act (so far as they are not yet in force) come into force in relation to England and Wales on 27th June 2012.</Text>
</P1para>

<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-c2e110"/>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 6 and 7, the following provisions of the Act (so far as they are not yet in force) come into force in relation to England and Wales on 1st July 2012—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 26 and Schedule 4 except insofar as the repeals and amendments made by that Schedule apply in relation to a police authority;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 27 except paragraph (k) of subsection (6);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/c" id="article-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 28 to 34; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/5/d" id="article-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 5 of Schedule 25 and section 237 so far as relating to that Part except insofar as the repeals set out in that Part apply in relation to a police authority.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-fb7f23"/>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following transitional, transitory and savings provisions have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7" id="article-7"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-42d31d"/>7</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/1" id="article-7-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Notwithstanding section 28(8)(b) of the Act, a person may be appointed by a relevant authority as the independent person under section 28(7) of the Act, if that person—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/1/a" id="article-7-1-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>is not a member or co-opted member of the standards committee of the relevant authority on 1st July 2012; but</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/1/b" id="article-7-1-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>has held such a post at any time during the 5 years ending on 30th June 2012.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2" id="article-7-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Paragraph (1) only applies in relation to appointments made before 1st July 2013.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2A" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2A" id="article-7-2A"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">2A</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">A person who falls within the description in sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (1) may not be appointed for a period ending on or after 1st July 2013.</Addition></Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2B" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2B" id="article-7-2B"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">2B</Addition></Pnumber><P2para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">Paragraph (2A) does not apply in relation to an appointment—</Addition></Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2B/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2B/a" id="article-7-2B-a"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">a</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">made before 24th July 2012; and</Addition></Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2B/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/2B/b" id="article-7-2B-b"><Pnumber><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">b</Addition></Pnumber><P3para><Text><Addition ChangeId="key-965cba-1784113635461" CommentaryRef="key-965cba">where the period of the appointment ends on or after 1st July 2013.</Addition></Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3" id="article-7-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Notwithstanding article 5, the provisions of the 2000 Act, and any regulations made under them, which are repealed or amended by sections 26 and 237 of, and Schedule 4 and Part 5 of Schedule 25 to, the Act continue to have effect for the purposes of—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3/a" id="article-7-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the bringing of an appeal under regulation 21 of the Standards Committee (England) Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3/b" id="article-7-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>proceedings before the First-tier Tribunal on a referral under section 64(3)(b) or 65(4) of the 2000 Act or under regulation 17 of the Standards Committee (England) Regulations 2008 or on an appeal under regulation 21 of those Regulations; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/3/c" id="article-7-3-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>legal proceedings associated with proceedings on a referral or an appeal,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>where proceedings were commenced before 1st July 2012 or relate to a decision by a standards committee made before 1st July 2012.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/4" id="article-7-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>This paragraph applies where, immediately before the commencement of the provisions referred to in article 5—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/4/a" id="article-7-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>an allegation or case that relates to a person who is a member or co-opted member of a relevant authority has been referred to the standards committee of the authority; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/4/b" id="article-7-4-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the standards committee has not made a finding in respect of that allegation or case.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/5" id="article-7-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In paragraph (4), “standards committee”, “relevant authority”, “member” and “co-opted member” have the same meaning as in Part 3 of the 2000 Act.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/6" id="article-7-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where paragraph (4) applies, the allegation or case shall be treated as having been made under Chapter 7 of Part 1 of the Act.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1463/article/7/7" id="article-7-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Notwithstanding the amendment of sections 49(6) and 83 of the 2000 Act by Schedule 4 to the Act, those sections shall continue to have effect in their un-amended form for the purposes of the definition of “relevant authority” in sections 92 and 101 of the 2000 Act.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3para>

<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>

<Text>section 107, in so far as it is not already in force,</Text>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 3, in so far as it is not already in force,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/f" id="article-3-f">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1569/article/3/g" id="article-3-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) (Amendment) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-07-02"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1714/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1714/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1714/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1714/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Localism Act 2011 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) (Amendment) Order 2012 and shall come into force on the day after the day on which it is made.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1714/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1714/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) Order 2012 (S.I. 2012/1463 (c.56))">the Order</Abbreviation>” means the Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) Order 2012<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1714/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1714/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1714/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1714/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Article 7 of the Order is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1714/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1714/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After paragraph (2) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A person who falls within the description in sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (1) may not be appointed for a period ending on or after 1st July 2013.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraph (2A) does not apply in relation to an appointment—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>made before 24th July 2012; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>where the period of the appointment ends on or after 1st July 2013.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Insofar as they are not already in force, the following provisions of the Act shall come into force in accordance with this Order.

UK_uksi_2012_1831/4e84ea6326.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Health and Social Care Act 2012 (Commencement No.2 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-07-11"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-5497d3"/>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Health and Social Care Act 2012 (Commencement No.2 and Transitional, Savings and Transitory Provisions) Order 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Health and Social Care Act 2012 c. 7">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Health and Social Care Act 2012;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="National Health Service Act 2006 c. 41">2006 Act</Abbreviation>” means the National Health Service Act 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="National Health Service Commissioning Board">the Board</Abbreviation>” means the National Health Service Commissioning Board established under section 1H of the 2006 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Board Authority” means the Special Health Authority established under the <Acronym Expansion="National Health Service">NHS</Acronym> Commissioning Board Authority (Establishment and Constitution) Order 2011<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“financial year” means the period which begins on 1st April and ends on the following 31st March;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“initial period” has the meaning given in paragraph 1(2) of Schedule 6 to the Act.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-e9cacf"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Insofar as they are not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, the following provisions of the Act shall come into force in accordance with this Order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>1st October 2012 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Act—</Text>
<Text>section 1 (Secretary of State’s duty to promote the comprehensive health service) only insofar as it—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>substitutes section 1(1) of the 2006 Act, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/1831/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>relates to the Board’s duty under section 1H(2) and (3)(b) of the 2006 Act;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>section 9(1) (the National Health Service Commissioning Board) only insofar as it inserts section 1H(1), (2), (3)(b) and (4) into the 2006 Act (the NHS Commissioning Board and its general functions);</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 9(2) and Schedule 1 (the National Health Service Commissioning Board), except insofar as it inserts paragraph 17 of Schedule A1 into the 2006 Act (interim accounts);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 10 (clinical commissioning groups) only insofar as it inserts section 1I(1) into the 2006 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 17(13) (powers in relation to research) only insofar as it confers powers on the Board;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 21 (functions of Special Health Authorities);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 22 (exercise of public health functions of the Secretary of State) for the purpose only of enabling—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the Secretary of State to arrange for the Board or a clinical commissioning group to exercise public health functions of the Secretary of State on or after the date on which section 22 comes fully into force, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the Board to arrange for a clinical commissioning group to exercise public health functions under section 7A(4) of the 2006 Act on or after the date on which section 22 comes fully into force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 23 (the National Health Service Commissioning Board: further provision) only insofar as it inserts into the 2006 Act—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 13A to 13D,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13E(1) to (3) and (4)(a),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 13F to 13J,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 13K(1) and 13L,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13N,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13P,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13R,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13T for the purpose only of the first business plan of the Board for the financial year ending 31st March 2014 and subsequent financial years;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13U, except for section 13U(2)(c),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13W,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13Y,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 13Z to 13Z3, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 13Z4(1), except insofar as the definition of “health services” relates to section 13Q;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 24 (financial arrangements for the Board) only insofar as it inserts section 223B(2) and (3) into the 2006 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 25(1) (clinical commissioning groups: establishment <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>), except insofar as it inserts section 14I into the 2006 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Schedule 2 only insofar as it inserts the following paragraphs of Schedule 1A into the 2006 Act—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 10,</Text>

</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/264/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/264/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of section 86 of the Water Act 2003 so far as not already in force is 6th April 2012.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2012_2913/7b2c15cea2.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No. 8 and Transitional, Transitory and Savings Provisions) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-11-20"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Localism Act 2011 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 8 and Transitional, Transitory and Savings Provisions) Order 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 2000 c. 22">2000 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“allegation” means an allegation in writing that relates to the conduct of a member of a police authority where that alleged conduct occurred prior to the commencement date;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“commencement date” means the 22nd November 2012;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“elected member” means a member of a county, district or county borough council appointed to a police authority in accordance with regulation 7 of the Police Authority Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“host authority”, in relation to an independent member, means the local authority which is being provided by the Secretary of State with financial resources in connection with the exercise of functions by or in relation to the Police and Crime Panel<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> in the area of the independent member’s former police authority<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“independent member” means an independent member of a police authority who was appointed in accordance with regulation 9 of the Police Authority Regulations 2008;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“member” means an elected or independent member;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“police authority” means a police authority in England or Wales established under section 3 of the Police Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“relevant local authority” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in the case of an elected member, the relevant council within the meaning given by paragraph 8 of Schedule 2 to the Police Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> of which that person is a member; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in the case of an independent member, the host authority in relation to that member.</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 3, 4, 5 and 6, the following provisions of the Localism Act 2011 come into force in relation to England and Wales on the commencement date—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 36 so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 26 and Schedule 4 so far as they relate to police authorities; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 5 of Schedule 25 and section 237 so far as relating to that Part, so far as they relate to police authorities.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the amendment of sections 49(6) and 83 of the 2000 Act by Schedule 4 to the Localism Act 2011, those sections shall continue to have effect in their un-amended form for the purposes of the definition of “relevant authority” in Part 3 of the 2000 Act for the purposes of the transitional provisions made by this Order.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article applies where an allegation concerning a member of a police authority in England is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the commencement date, to the police authority and in respect of which no finding has been made by the standards committee of that authority; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on or after the commencement date but before 20th December 2012, to the relevant local authority in relation to that member.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this article applies—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the allegation shall be treated as having been made to the relevant local authority under Chapter 7 of Part 1 of the Localism Act 2011;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant local authority shall deal with the allegation in accordance with the standards arrangements the authority is required to have in place under that Act; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/c" id="article-4-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 28 of that Act has effect as though—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/c/i" id="article-4-2-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>references to a relevant authority’s code of conduct are references to the code of conduct of the police authority of the member who is the subject of an allegation, and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/2/c/ii" id="article-4-2-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>references to an allegation have the same meaning as in this Order.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notwithstanding article 2—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/3/a" id="article-4-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 50 of the 2000 Act and any order made under that section, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/4/3/b" id="article-4-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 51 of that Act and any code adopted under that section,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>continue to have effect for the purposes of enabling an allegation to be dealt with in accordance with this article.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding article 2, the provisions of the 2000 Act, and any regulations made under them, which are repealed or amended by sections 26 and 237 of, and Schedule 4 and Part 5 of Schedule 25 to, the Act continue to have effect for the purposes of—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the bringing of an appeal under regulation 21 of the Standards Committee (England) Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>proceedings before the First Tier Tribunal on a referral under section 64(3)(b) or 65(4) of the 2000 Act or under regulation 17 of the Standards Committee (England) Regulations 2008 or on an appeal under regulation 21 of those Regulations; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/5/c" id="article-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>legal proceedings associated with proceedings on an appeal or referral,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>where proceedings were commenced before 22nd November 2012 or relate to a finding made by a standards committee before 22nd November 2012.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article applies—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where an allegation concerning a member of a police authority in Wales is made to the Public Services Ombudsman for Wales—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/a/i" id="article-6-1-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>before the commencement date and in respect of which no determination has been made; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/a/ii" id="article-6-1-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>on or after the commencement date but before 20th December 2012; or</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/1/b" id="article-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case in which the Public Services Ombudsman for Wales considers that a member of a police authority in Wales has failed, or may have failed, to comply with the authority’s code of conduct prior to the commencement date and which has come to the Ombudsman’s attention as a result of an investigation arising from an allegation made in accordance with paragraph (a) or (b).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this article applies—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/a" id="article-6-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the provisions in Chapters 3 and 4 of Part 3 of the 2000 Act, and any regulations made under them, shall continue to apply to a member of a police authority in Wales as though the member was a member or co-opted member of a relevant authority in Wales; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b" id="article-6-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the allegation or case shall be determined in accordance with the provisions in the 2000 Act but with the following modifications—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/i" id="article-6-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>an investigation may not determine the finding that a matter should be referred to a monitoring officer under section 69(4)(c) or (5), and section 71(2) and (4)(b) shall therefore not apply;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/ii" id="article-6-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>where an investigation is ceased before completion, the matters under investigation may not be referred to a monitoring officer under section 70(4) or (5);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/iii" id="article-6-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the requirements in section 71(1)(c) and (3)(c) to send a report to the monitoring officer and in section 71(1)(d) to inform the monitoring officer of the outcome of the investigation, do not apply;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/iv" id="article-6-2-b-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in section 73(7) the references to the Public Services Ombudsman for Wales referring any matter to the monitoring officer under section 70(4) or (5) or 71(2) or (4) shall not apply; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/2/b/v" id="article-6-2-b-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in section 79, if the person concerned is a member of another relevant authority in Wales, any notice required to be given to a standards committee under subsection (2), (7), (8) or (10) must instead be given to the standards committee of that other relevant authority and subsection (11) has effect accordingly.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notwithstanding article 2—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/3/a" id="article-6-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 50 of the 2000 Act and any order made under that section, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/2913/article/6/3/b" id="article-6-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 51 of that Act and any code adopted under that section,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>continue to have effect for the purposes of enabling an allegation or case to be determined in accordance with this article.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

UK_uksi_2012_411/482ec725d7.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Localism Act 2011 (Commencement No. 3) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-02-17"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Localism Act 2011 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3) Order 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “<Abbreviation Expansion="Localism Act 2011 c. 20">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Localism Act 2011.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act (so far as they are not yet in force) come into force, in relation to England and Wales, the day after the day on which this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 1 except subsection (7);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 2 to 8;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 9 except —</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/2/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/2/c/i" id="article-2-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>subsection (1) so far as it inserts—</Text>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/411/article/2/c/i/aa/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/411/article/2/c/i/aa" id="article-2-c-i-aa">
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>new sections 5A and 5B so far as relating to fire and rescue authorities in Wales;</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>

</P4para></P4>

</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of Chapter 1 of Part 1 of the Act (green deal) come into force on the day after this Order is made so far as is necessary for the purposes set out in paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 1 and 2 (green deal plans);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/c" id="article-3-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>

</P3para></P3>

</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The purposes are –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions shall continue to apply and have effect as if the provisions had not been repealed or amended in relation to an application made to the Secretary of State before the coming into force of sections 82 to 92 and Schedule 2 of the Act–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 10E to 10F of the Pipe-lines Act 1962<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> (provisions for securing that upstream petroleum pipe-lines are so used as to reduce necessity for construction of other etc);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 of the Gas Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> (acquisition of rights to use gas processing facilities);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/c" id="article-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/d" id="article-4-d">

<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>

</P3para></P3>
